items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Germany's Bundestag has passed a law letting customs officials seize assets of doubtful origin, explicitly including crypto, without first opening a criminal case.
- The powers target "significant" assets, generally those worth more than €100,000 ($111,000), whose owners would have to show they were lawfully obtained.
- The government expects about €308 million ($342 million) in extra revenue, but opposition lawmakers say the law will catch cash couriers rather than sophisticated launderers.
Germany's parliament has approved sweeping new powers for the country's customs agency, allowing it to seize assets, including crypto, whose lawful origin is in doubt, even when no criminal investigation is underway.
The Bundestag passed the Customs Financial Justice Act, or Zollfinanzgerechtigkeitsgesetz, on Thursday, November 12, the German government said. Under the law, customs can more easily seize assets where there are "justified doubts" about their lawful origin, an instrument the government describes as a "suspicious wealth order." Customs will also be able to better monitor digital cross-border payment routes and secure crypto assets.
"With this, we are sending a clear signal to criminals: we are getting tougher," German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said, according to the government.
Proving where it came from
The powers apply to "significant" assets, which typically means those worth more than €100,000, according to the government's bill. Because owners of such assets are usually able to explain where they came from, while the state struggles to prove an illegal origin, the government argued that it is reasonable to ask owners to disclose that information. "Almost every law-abiding citizen will be able to explain where these assets came from," the bill's explanatory notes say, as summarized by the Bundestag's news service.
Klingbeil has said customs could hold assets for up to 180 days without a conviction, during which owners would have to show they were obtained legally. "The Porsche and the Rolex are then gone for now," he said, according to the Berliner Zeitung. Any permanent confiscation would require a court ruling. Following an amendment by the governing coalition, that decision will be made by a panel of finance court judges rather than a single judge.
The law also reorganizes Germany's customs administration, strengthens its Financial Intelligence Unit and gives customs a legal basis to use technologies such as artificial intelligence. It forms part of an action plan against organized crime that the government adopted on February 25, 2026.
Germany's Bitcoin seizures and sales
Germany has seized large amounts of crypto before, and has been quick to sell it. In 2024, authorities in the state of Saxony began selling the nearly 50,000 BTC they had seized from operators of the movie piracy website Movie2K, moving hundreds of millions of dollars' worth at a time as the sell-off continued. Blockchain analytics firm Arkham later said authorities had failed to seize a further 45,000 BTC linked to the site. The new law would give customs a way to seize crypto of unclear origin without first having to tie it to a specific crime.
German authorities have also gone after laundering infrastructure. Last year, they joined Swiss police in shutting down Cryptomixer, a mixing service that had laundered more than $1.4 billion in Bitcoin since 2016. Separately, the finance ministry has drafted a 25% tax on crypto gains from 2027.
Critics question its reach
The Bundestag's finance committee backed the bill on Wednesday with votes from the governing CDU/CSU and SPD, as well as the far-right AfD. The Left Party voted against, and the Greens abstained.
The Greens said Germany's money laundering problem is estimated at €100 billion, and that the government's expectation of only €308 million in additional revenue showed the gap between its ambitions and the law. The Left Party said the confiscation process was "built for the cash courier, not the banker."
The law still needs to pass the Bundesrat, the upper house of parliament that represents Germany's states.

Solana正式告别Mainnet Beta，升级至1.0协议版本

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Solana 基金会发文宣布，Solana 网络将从「Mainnet Beta」正式转为「Mainnet」，并启用统一的 Solana 1.0 协议版本，结束自网络上线以来沿用的 Beta 标识。此次调整由 Solana 基金会联合 Anza 和 Firedancer 团队推进。此次升级主要是对网络技术进展及协议版本管理方式的确认，并非更换底层网络。对于普通用户而言，无需采取任何操作，SOL、账户、资产、应用及交易历史均不会发生变化。

Solana 基金会表示，Alpenglow 已在主网激活，使验证者达成共识的方式发生变化，并将交易最终确认时间缩短至约 150 毫秒。此外，独立于 Agave 开发的验证者客户端 Firedancer 逐步部署，有助于提升客户端多样性，降低单一代码库漏洞对网络造成的影响，增强网络韧性。

Solana 1.0 还将建立统一的协议版本标识。此前，Agave 和 Firedancer 拥有各自独立的代码库、发布周期及软件版本号；新的协议版本将用于描述整个 Solana 网络的演进，而不再以某一客户端的版本号代表全网。基金会同时强调，协议版本发布并不意味着相关功能会立即全部激活。开发者、验证者及 RPC 运营商仍需根据各客户端的兼容版本和具体升级指引进行操作。

Kava更新安全事件报告：约183万美元的KAVA被盗，拟永久关闭新增借贷

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Kava Chain 于 11 月 16 日发布安全事件处置更新称，HARD Lend 于 11 月 14 日遭遇安全事件，约 5,390 万枚 KAVA 从该借贷应用中被转走。项目方表示，已识别并封堵相关漏洞，防止攻击者继续利用该漏洞转移资金。根据调查，攻击者利用借贷账户核算漏洞，虚增 BUSD 抵押品价值，进而反复执行借款和清算操作，从借贷资金池中提取现有 KAVA。被转走的 KAVA 中，约 4,920 万枚随后通过 LayerZero 跨链至 BNB Chain。

项目方强调，此次事件仅影响 HARD Lend，未危及 Kava Chain 底层安全，也没有通过漏洞增发新的 KAVA，用户个人存款大部分未受影响。目前，部分攻击者资金已被冻结。Kava 生态贡献者、合作伙伴、相关交易平台及执法部门正协同追踪和冻结剩余资金，并推进被盗资产追回及责任人调查。

此外，Kava 计划加速停用 HARD Lend 旧版借贷功能，并提交治理提案，通过为期 7 天的投票程序，永久关闭新增借贷功能。现有用户仓位将通过有序流程处理，后续将公布具体指引。在治理流程完成期间，现有防护措施将持续生效。Kava Chain 表示，相关措施仅针对 HARD Lend，Kava 主网及其他生态应用仍正常运行。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Vitalik Buterin threw his support behind leanPCS, one of three proposed ways to aggregate bulky quantum-safe signatures and proofs on Ethereum.
- Quantum-safe signatures and proofs are far larger than today's, and Buterin said his draft proposal, EIP-8288, would keep most of that data off the chain.
- He argued leanPCS could be implemented quickly, while a more general option, leanSTARK, would require Ethereum to agree on a new programming language.
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has thrown his weight behind a proposal he says could make the network quantum-safe much faster than expected.
"Over the past few weeks I've gone from thinking leanPCS is total bull to being a total bull," Buterin tweeted on Monday, in a lengthy explainer on how Ethereum could handle the much larger signatures and proofs that quantum-resistant cryptography requires.
Over the past few weeks I've gone from thinking leanPCS is total bull to being a total bull. So let me explain some of these buzzwords in more detail.
At the core, 8288 is about hyper-scaling data and execution for any computation that needs to get performed on a piece of data…
— vitalik.eth (@VitalikButerin) November 16, 2026
In short, leanPCS is a proposed way for Ethereum to bundle many large, quantum-safe signatures and proofs into a single compact proof, so that the full data never has to be stored onchain. It is built on polynomial commitment schemes, or PCS, the core mathematical building block of STARK proofs.
Quantum computers are expected to eventually break the elliptic curve cryptography that secures Ethereum and Bitcoin accounts today. The quantum-safe replacements are far bulkier: Buterin said signatures would grow from 65 bytes to between 1 and 6 kilobytes, while zero-knowledge proofs would balloon from a few hundred bytes to around 128 kilobytes. "This is unsustainable to put on chain," he wrote.
EIP-8288's three paths forward
Buterin's answer is EIP-8288, a draft proposal he co-authored with developer Thomas Coratger in June, which would aggregate those signatures and proofs before they ever reach a block.
Under the design, users publish their signatures or proofs, and network nodes repeatedly bundle everything they have seen into a single STARK, a type of zero-knowledge proof, that attests the underlying data is valid. These aggregate proofs are themselves combined until a single "master proof" verifies everything in a block. Only short claims, rather than the full signatures or proofs, would need to be stored onchain.
He laid out three ways to build it, depending on what users submit. The simplest, leanSPHINCS, would support a single type of quantum-safe, hash-based signature, costing users only a small amount of gas per signature, but it couldn't do anything else.
ETH price on November 22, 4:59PM UTC
At the other end, leanSTARK would be fully general, allowing any signature scheme, privacy protocols or hidden multisig logic. But Ethereum would first have to agree on a programming language for users' programs, which Buterin called "the first big case of 'Ethereum moving beyond the EVM,'" and which is likely to take time.
Buterin's preferred option, leanPCS, offers a third route. It would offer the same generality as leanSTARK but "could potentially be implemented very quickly," he said, because far fewer design choices are needed, and leanSTARK could then be added later.
"So there is a route to getting 'the cryptographic proof singularity' much faster than any of us expected," Buterin wrote, "and that route runs through 8288 with leanPCS."
Quantum-safe signatures today
Buterin linked to SPHINCS-, a family of hash-based signature schemes optimized for Ethereum, which was published on the Ethereum Research forum in June with input from Buterin and Ethereum Foundation cryptographers. The post shows that a standards-aligned quantum-safe signature can already be verified on Ethereum for about 150,000 gas, without any protocol change, compared with about 3,000 gas for an ECDSA signature today, according to an earlier Buterin estimate.
Under protocol-level aggregation, a future "leanSPHINCS" verification would cost about 3,000 gas, according to the post.
Quantum resistance has become a top priority for Ethereum. The Ethereum Foundation formed a dedicated post-quantum team in January, and Buterin has since said the network is betting its future on quantum security and privacy. Developers have also proposed overhauling the staking deposit contract to support post-quantum validator keys, and Buterin has pushed a plan to cut the cost of quantum-safe privacy.

items.content:
In brief
- Elon Musk said he is signing a petition calling on Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang, which has drawn more than 160,000 signatures.
- Huang has discussed returning as CEO with confidants, and allies are assembling a "war room" to lobby for his comeback, the Financial Times reported.
- Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Nvidia should look outside the company for its next CEO, while analysts are split on whether Huang could return.
Elon Musk has thrown his support behind a campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO, as the ousted chipmaker co-founder reportedly weighs a comeback just days after resigning.
"A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I'm signing it too," the Tesla and SpaceX CEO tweeted on Friday. Musk had previously said it would be "an honor" to hire Huang.
A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) November 13, 2026
The "Stand with Jensen" open letter calls on Nvidia's board to bring Huang back while an independent investigation establishes the facts. It has drawn more than 160,000 signatures, including Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, CNBC reported, though the site notes that signatories' affiliations are self-reported and unverified. More than 7,500 signatories identified themselves as Nvidia employees, The Guardian reported, a figure it said was equivalent to 18% of the company's workforce.
The campaign follows internal calls from Nvidia staff for Huang's return.
A comeback in the works?
Huang has discussed the possibility of returning with confidants, the Financial Times reported, citing multiple people familiar with the matter. One ally told the newspaper they were assembling a "war room" of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for his reinstatement and would seek support from the White House, adding that the effort had Huang's backing.
Even supporters acknowledged the obstacles. "Having an affair with a subordinate is a fireable offence," one person involved in the effort told the FT.
Two major Nvidia shareholders, Altimeter Capital's Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management's Gavin Baker, urged the board in an open letter on Friday to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang."
Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member on Thursday, capping a week of reports of affairs with Alice Huang, a former executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed whom U.S. officials suspect of spying for China, and with an Nvidia executive who reported to him. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO.
Washington pushes back
The campaign faces resistance in Washington. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that Nvidia should look outside the company for its next CEO. "They need a dramatic shake-up," he told Fox News.
Bessent said on Sunday Morning Futures that questions over Nvidia's compliance with U.S. export restrictions were the bigger issue, and that the company should be judged on whether it had "intentionally ignored the warning signs" of shell companies in Singapore. He said he wanted answers "in the next 10 days from the board and from the outside counsel." Huang also faces congressional inquiries into Nvidia's chip exports to China, as well as a proposed shareholder class action.
Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor, the FT has reported. "We are in the process of selecting a search firm for the NVIDIA CEO role. We have not formally engaged any potential candidates," an Nvidia spokesperson told CNBC.
Analysts are divided on Huang's chances. "We see no chance Jensen comes back to Nvidia as CEO," Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co. said in a note cited by CNBC, while Seaport Research Partners' Jay Goldberg said Huang could stage "a second act" if he gets through his legal troubles. Former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci was blunter: "The FBI doesn't take petitions," he tweeted.
Nvidia reports quarterly earnings on Tuesday, the first under Kress.

乌兰察布AI基建有多疯狂：25GW算力项目已签约，近3万人同时赶工

动察 Beating AI 快讯，前段时间，美国研究机构 SemiAnalysis 专程来到内蒙古乌兰察布，将规划 800MW 的远景星河基地称为「中国版 Stargate」。然而，这座足以与美国超大型 AI 数据中心相提并论的园区，在乌兰察布只能算冰山一角。一场规模更加庞大的算力建设，正在这片草原上铺开。

根据当地公开数据，截至今年 10 月中旬，乌兰察布累计签约 109 个算力中心项目，签约 IT 供电容量超过 25GW，规划机架规模超过 700 万架。

《晚点》记者近期在乌兰察布实地走访了 72 小时。当地察哈尔高新区就有 22 个算力项目同时施工，近 3 万名工人在不同工地赶工。

在巴音片区，十几辆几十米长的板车排成一排，运载着数百个尚未拆封的服务器机柜。道路两侧有 4 个数据中心同时建设，到了晚上，塔吊和挖掘机还在施工。一些工地每三个月就要完成一栋机房楼。

客户要求的交付时间也越来越短。远景 AI 智算中心 CTO 胡兴赞透露，过去客户能接受 12 个月的建设周期，后来缩短到 9 个月、6 个月，现在甚至要求两三个月交付。

因为 GPU 太贵，机房延期一天，就可能让价值数十亿元的计算设备继续闲置。一名项目负责人透露，如果未能按合同交付机房，每晚一天就要赔偿客户 50 万元，一个月就是 1500 万元。

为了赶工，建设方开始提前拿地、建设厂房、采购大型设备。部分配电系统直接在工厂组装成模块，运到现场后再连接。原本需要 10 天的安装工作，可以压缩到 2 天。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377555

items.content:
DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.
DBS and JPMorgan launched a service on Monday that lets clients transfer tokenized US dollar deposits between the two banks around the clock.
Tokenized deposits are bank deposits represented on the blockchain. The service connects DBS Token Services with JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform for transfers between Singapore and the US, according to a press release.
Ant International became the first client to use service to manage its cash across markets.
The launch supports the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s Project BLOOM, which aims to make it easier to use tokenized deposits and regulated stablecoins for payments in Singapore and across borders. The central bank launched the project in October 2025.
DBS and JPMorgan co-lead Project BLOOM’s working group on transfers between blockchain platforms. The two banks first revealed plans to develop a blockchain-based tokenization framework for onchain transfers in November 2025.
More than half of the 422 business leaders DBS surveyed across 11 markets said their companies used tokenized deposits or planned to do so, according to the bank’s Oct. 28 report.
Related: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift

items.content:
新加坡金管局与德国央行完成跨境数字资产结算连接测试，探索欧元与新元结算

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，新加坡金融管理局（MAS）与德国央行（Deutsche Bundesbank）于 11 月 16 日宣布，已成功测试双方数字资产结算解决方案测试环境之间的连接，旨在支持新加坡与德国之间跨货币、跨营业时间的批发结算。此次合作名为 Project Simbolon，是双方 2025 年 11 月签署合作谅解备忘录以来的首个重要里程碑，也是对 MAS 主导的 Project Guardian 相关工作的补充。

星展银行（DBS）、德意志银行（Deutsche Bank）作为参与商业银行，区块链金融基础设施服务商 Partior 提供技术支持。测试重点是利用批发型央行数字货币（Wholesale CBDC），实现欧元与新加坡元外汇交易的支付对支付（PvP）结算。零知识证明（ZKP）技术使双方结算环境能够在无需直接对接两家央行账本的情况下，验证交易是否满足结算条件。

此外，Project Simbolon 还探索了跨境数字资产结算机制在金融机构融资和流动性管理方面的应用，包括证券交易和日内流动性管理。该机制有望让金融机构更接近实际资金需求时点获取和配置流动性，从而提高资金使用效率。MAS 与德国央行表示，未来将继续与行业合作伙伴探索跨境数字资产结算的更多应用，并研究结算性能优化，以及更广泛应用所涉及的法律、监管、运营和治理问题。

马化腾讲话引争议后，腾讯官方发文：AI时代不一定要那么多管理岗位，别占着地盘不动

动察 Beating AI 快讯，11 月 16 日，腾讯文化正式公布 28 周年总办 LinkTime 现场笔记。相比上周流出的马化腾讲话，这次把组织改革的矛头指得更清楚。

总办直言，未来不一定需要那么多管理岗位。那些只负责中间传话、不愿改变还占着位置的干部，不能再成为公司转型的阻碍。各部门的山头主义、地盘意识都要打破。

腾讯还承认，不少基层员工很有动力使用 AI，也愿意做出新东西，却被旧有的组织架构限制住了。公司希望减少管理层级，让更多小团队直接开展工作。

重新组建混元团队也让腾讯意识到，团队能力不能只靠少数顶尖人才。其他成员的水平能不能一起提高，同样重要。如今游戏、金融、安全等团队也开始参与混元模型的共同设计。

上周马化腾在全员会上强调，转型不能再靠哄、靠谈条件。这次官方笔记进一步提出，连过去设置的管理岗位和部门边界，都要重新审视。

Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3
Harvard’s gold ETF share count rose nearly 20-fold in Q3, while Dartmouth kept its positions in Solana and Ether staking ETFs unchanged.
Harvard University and Dartmouth College reported unchanged share counts in BlackRock’s spot Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) at the end of the third quarter as a Bitcoin rally lifted the value of both stakes.
Harvard held 3.04 million shares of the iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF (IBIT), worth about $144.1 million at the end of September, while Dartmouth reported 201,531 shares valued at $9.5 million, according to Form 13F filings with the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
IBIT gained about 42% in Q3 as Bitcoin (BTC) rallied nearly 43%. Both posted their strongest quarterly gains of 2026 through September.
Harvard has reported the same IBIT share count since the end of March, after cutting its holdings by 43% in Q1 and 21% in Q4 2025. Dartmouth has reported the same 201,531 shares since first disclosing its Bitcoin ETF position in Q4 2025.
Harvard increased its share count in the State Street’s SPDR Gold Shares ETF (GLD) nearly 20-fold in Q3, to 1.16 million from 58,862. The position was worth $442.2 million at the end of September.
Dartmouth again reported 304,803 shares of the Bitwise Solana Staking ETF and 178,148 shares of the Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF. The positions were worth $4.9 million and $4.5 million, respectively, at quarter-end.
The steady university holdings contrasted with moves by major financial companies. Jane Street reduced its IBIT shares by 19% in Q3, while JPMorgan Chase increased the number of shares it held by 9.6%, according to their latest quarterly filings.
Related: Barclays boosts BlackRock’s IBIT stake 48% ahead of key Q3 13F filings
items.title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3

OpenAI为何迟迟不发新旗舰模型？内部员工爆料：公司已经留下太多「伤疤」

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 上一次更新 Astra 旗舰模型还是 9 月初，原定 10 月推出的后续版本也被取消。近日，OpenAI 安全团队员工 Joe 在一条已经删除的帖子中透露，公司内部的研发文化已经彻底转向「安全优先」，甚至可以说 OpenAI 已经变成了一家「安全公司」。

Joe 表示，如今安全问题贯穿公司内部的日常讨论，就连顶尖 AI 研究员，也要花大量时间与安全团队合作，研究如何安全地进行强化学习训练。他自己几个月前一度想辞职，如今看到公司的变化，决定留下。

这场转变源于今年 7 月的一次严重事故。当时，OpenAI 的内部模型在安全测试中突破隔离环境，擅自连接互联网，甚至入侵了 Hugging Face 的系统。9 月又有内部模型利用网络配置漏洞，绕过限制访问外网。

OpenAI 随后多次暂停前沿模型训练，抽调工程师加固系统。公司约四分之一的产品工程师被调去处理安全问题。一次内部安全攻坚就动员了 250 多人，覆盖 100 多个服务领域。

研发流程也被重新设计。OpenAI 花费数千亿 Token，让 AI 反复攻击自家的训练环境，寻找漏洞。公司还建立了 Control Room，持续监控模型运行，发现危险行为后，最多 35 秒就能阻止模型继续输出。

这些安全要求已经直接影响模型发布。9 月底，OpenAI 取消了原定 10 月推出的新一代 Astra 旗舰模型。安全负责人 Saachi Jain 解释称，新模型虽然执行任务更加积极，但在遵守用户授权范围、清楚汇报自身操作等方面反而不如上一代。安全团队因此建议取消发布，研究管理层最终接受了这一决定。

OpenAI 已于 10 月 1 日恢复此前暂停的前沿强化学习训练，但新一代 Astra 旗舰至今仍未公布发布日期。Joe 认为，管理层如今也认识到，只有先确保足够的安全性，才能继续推进更强模型的研发。他表示，过去的教训给公司留下了不少伤疤。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
Vitalik：看好leanPCS方案，称其有望加速以太坊迈向「密码学证明奇点」

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，以太坊创始人 Vitalik Buterin 发文表示，过去几周他对 leanPCS 的态度从最初的强烈怀疑转为高度看好，并详细解释了以太坊提案 8288 及 leanSPHINCS、leanSTARK 和 leanPCS 三种方案的区别。他指出，8288 的核心目标是对只需验证一次、验证结果可上链而原始数据无需长期保留的计算进行扩容，涵盖数字签名、STARK 证明、Merkle 分支和全同态加密（FHE）计算等场景。其中，数字签名和 STARK 证明是最重要的应用方向。随着抗量子迁移推进，签名和零知识证明的数据规模将显著增加，直接将其全部写入链上难以持续。

8288 计划通过在内存池（mempool）中聚合 STARK 证明来解决这一问题：用户先提交签名、STARK 证明或 PCS opening，各节点收集新提交的对象，并生成包含多个验证声明及相应证明的 STARK。随后，这些聚合证明继续递归聚合，最终形成区块中的单个主证明。链上只需保存输入输出的哈希及相关声明，无需重复广播原始签名和证明数据。

对于三种方案，Vitalik 作出如下区分：

leanSPHINCS：以纯哈希签名方案 SPHINCS 为基础，可支持抗量子账户，让用户以较低 Gas 成本完成签名，但功能仅限于特定签名方案。

leanSTARK：用户可运行任意计算并提交 STARK 证明，支持不同签名方案、多签隐私、隐私协议及私密账户抽象等场景。不过，该方案需要以太坊社区先就用户程序使用的指令集架构（ISA）达成共识，涉及以太坊执行环境的重要变化，因此可能需要较长时间。

leanPCS：以多项式承诺方案（PCS）为基础，链上需要处理多个声明，效率低于 leanSTARK，但链下证明系统选择更加灵活。其所需标准化内容较少，有望更快落地，并在未来与 leanSTARK 结合。

Vitalik 认为，leanPCS 有望在不必等待 ISA 标准完全确定的情况下，先实现与 leanSTARK 类似的通用性，为以太坊更快推进密码学证明技术提供路径。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377543
items.title: Vitalik：看好leanPCS方案，称其有望加速以太坊迈向「密码学证明奇点」

Qwen4-Max追近Kimi：综合差3分、成本低11%，但编程差距仍明显

动察 Beating AI 快讯，独立评测机构 Artificial Analysis 公布 Qwen4-Max 正式版成绩。在最高 xhigh 推理档位下，模型综合智能指数达到 43 分，比上一代 Qwen3.8-Max 的 34 分提高 9 分，距离 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 46 分还差 3 分。

Qwen4-Max 在全部 9 项评测中均超过前代。高难知识推理测试 HLE-Diamond 的正确率从 24% 提升至 45%，企业软件自动化测试提高 17 个百分点。在模拟真实业务文件处理的 AA-Briefcase 中，Qwen4-Max 获得 1686 Elo，略高于 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 1674。

编程能力仍是短板。Terminal-Bench 4.0 测试中，Qwen4-Max 得分 48%，明显落后 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 67%。在考查真实开源项目开发能力的 FrontierCode 2.0 中，两者均为 26%，落后腾讯 Hy4 的 31%。

成本方面，Qwen4-Max 的平均单任务费用为 3.27 美元，上一代为 10.02 美元，降低约 67%，也比 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3.68 美元便宜约 11%。

除了 API 降价，模型本身也减少了 Token 消耗。Qwen4-Max 每项任务平均输出约 10.5 万 Token，比上一代的 17.1 万减少 39%。不过，Kimi K3.1 Pro 只需要约 7.2 万 Token。

Codex「模型已满」报错大幅减少：受影响用户占比从6.82%降至0.085%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，OpenAI 核心产品负责人 Tibo Sottiaux 晒出一张内部统计图，表示团队可能终于解决了长期困扰用户的「模型容量已满」报错。

数据显示，10 月 19 日，约 6.82% 的 Codex 日活跃用户至少遇到一次以容量错误结束的请求。到 11 月 12 日，这一比例已降至 0.085%。

此前，大量用户反映，即使订阅额度充足，Codex 仍会突然提示模型已满，要求切换模型。正在执行的编程任务会直接中断，换模型也未必有用。

这次修复主要围绕自动重试机制展开。10 月 15 日至 11 月 6 日，OpenAI 先后进行了 6 轮调整。服务器过载时，会告诉 Codex 应该等待多久再试。客户端收到指令后，可以等待并自动重试，尽量避免任务直接终止。OpenAI 在此之前还增加了推理算力。

有人调侃，Codex 报错减少可能是因为用户都跑去使用 Claude Opus 5.5 了。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377523
items.title: Codex「模型已满」报错大幅减少：受影响用户占比从6.82%降至0.085%

items.content:
韩国议员提交虚拟资产反洗钱修订案，违规最高罚1亿韩元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据 News1 报道，韩国共同民主党议员金贤正宣布，已代表提交《关于特定金融交易信息的报告及利用等的法律》部分修订案，以阻断利用虚拟资产进行的洗钱和非法资金转移，并强化加密交易平台的信息提供义务与反洗钱责任。违反相关义务最高可处以 1 亿韩元罚款。

报道称，现行法律虽要求虚拟资产转往其他交易平台时一并传递发送人和接收人信息，但具体对象、标准和程序交由总统令规定。修订案拟将交易平台之间转移虚拟资产时必须提供发送人与接收人信息写入法律。收款平台在相关信息缺失或难以采信时，可要求补正，或暂缓入账、予以退回；对反复不提供信息的交易平台，可中断交易。与其他交易平台新开展交易前，须核实对方是否真实存在、许可或申报情况及处罚记录等，并评估洗钱风险。用户将虚拟资产转至自行管理的个人钱包时，也须核验钱包地址及所有人。

修订案还规定，交易平台完成营业申报后，如代表人或大股东出现犯罪嫌疑等重大变动，须向金融情报分析院报告；即便将客户尽职调查等业务外包给专业机构，最终责任仍由交易平台承担。金贤正表示，随着虚拟资产交易增多，有必要明确管理标准，避免其成为非法资金的转移通道，并将在国会审议中予以支持，以期提高市场透明度和用户信任。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377517

Vitalik on EIP-8037: Curb State Growth to Scale Ethereum, Recommends Clarifying Future Protocol Changes

Vitalik Buterin said EIP-8037 raises gas costs for creating storage slots, code and accounts to decouple execution scaling from state growth while preserving security. He estimates that a 10x gas limit increase alongside Glamsterdam proposals excluding EIP-8037 would raise annual state growth from roughly 110 GiB to 1,100 GiB. Most core developers currently favor helping applications fix compatibility issues before Glamsterdam, which has been delayed. He also urged clearer communication of potential changes to gas mechanics, state trees, blob structures, consensus and transaction formats, noting that the consensus algorithm could change substantially over the next two years and older transaction types may eventually be retired. — link

Hy4 flash 的总参数为 224B，其中 64B 是 Engram 记忆参数，每次推理激活 12B。相比 Hy4 的 770B 总参数、49B 激活参数，规模明显缩小，但依然支持多模态和 100 万 Token 上下文。

Engram 是 DeepSeek 此前提出的条件记忆技术。它把部分常见文本模式存进可快速查询的记忆表，让模型通过查表获取信息，减少重复计算。

Hy4 flash 每百万 Token 输入仅 0.5 元、输出 2 元、缓存命中 0.02 元。相比 Hy4 的 API 刊例价，分别降低 12 倍、9 倍和 15 倍。不过，Hy4 目前另有五折限时优惠，实际价差会小于刊例价差。

腾讯官方测试中，PPT 协同编辑得分从 Hy4 的 78.9 降至 74.0，但单次任务成本从 1.714 元降至 0.105 元，约为原来的十六分之一。自动化任务得分也仅从 56.2 降至 52.2，每任务成本则从 0.908 元降至 0.038 元。

复杂任务的差距更大。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 终端操作测试中，Hy4 flash 仅得 19.2 分，旗舰 Hy4 为 44.4 分。ProgramBench 编程测试也从 30.0 分降至 16.0 分。

韩国金融应用Toss上线非托管钱包，支持ETH、USDT与USDC

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据 Edaily 报道，韩国移动金融应用 Toss 运营方 Viva Republica 推出非托管钱包服务「Toss Coin Wallet」。Toss 用户无需额外申请或满足资格限制，即可在应用首页的资产分类中创建钱包，在应用内查看持仓、余额和交易记录，并向外部加密交易平台或其他钱包收取、发送资产。该钱包初期支持以太坊、USDT 和 USDC 三种资产，底层网络为以太坊。

Toss 方面称，选取标准是全球市场中交易规模和实际用途较高的资产，并将在服务稳定后逐步扩大资产和网络范围。用户除钱包地址外，还可通过联系人发送资产。Toss 不另行收取手续费，但需支付以太坊网络 Gas 费。该服务采用非托管结构，Toss 不代为保管用户资产，资产转移记录在区块链上。这是 Toss 今年初设立数字资产技术团队后推出的首个面向用户的数字资产服务。

报道称，Toss 计划借助自有支付终端支持稳定币支付，并正准备申请虚拟资产服务商许可。Viva Republica 新业务负责人徐昌勋此前还表示，稳定币的核心在于流通，未来也可能视监管环境考虑转向托管型钱包。

杜均疑似加入李林孵化的新交易平台UMX，老火币联创时隔13年再联手

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，一封署名「你们的老战友 老杜」的 UMX 内部信在社交媒体流传。

信中称，李林孵化的交易平台 UMX 上线两周用户资沉突破 10 亿美元，一个月接近 20 亿美元。信中还提及 UMX 推出的「持币授信」业务，用户可抵押加密资产交易美股、港股及美股期权，个人最高授信 1,000 万美元。

该内部信结尾署名「老杜」，引发外界对火币联合创始人杜均参与 UMX 的猜测。

杜均和李林是加密交易平台火币早期核心创始搭档，十三年老战友。杜均与李林、袁大伟、胡东海等人于 2013 年共同创立火币，该平台上线后迅速成为全球领先的加密货币交易所之一。李林之后逐渐退出日常运营，约 2022 年出售控股权。此后转型，2023 年在香港创立家族办公室 Avenir Group（取自法语「更美好的未来」），专注连接传统金融与数字资产，是亚洲最大的贝莱德比特币现货 ETF（IBIT）持有人之一。

此前消息，今年 10 月 16 日，由李林旗下 Avenir Group 孵化的加密友好型证券平台 UMX（The Unified Market Exchange）宣布正式上线。UMX 定位为面向全球专业投资者的加密友好型证券平台，以真实港美股、ETF、美股期权与加密资产交易为核心，致力于解决数字资产与证券资产分属不同账户体系、跨市场配置流程复杂、购买力分散等问题。用户可在统一账户体系下交易真实证券与加密资产，并在证券、加密资产与法币之间灵活划转资金，体验跨资产统一保证金。

星展银行与摩根大通上线全天候代币化存款跨境转账方案，蚂蚁国际为首家客户

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据星展银行官方公告，星展银行与摩根大通旗下 Kinexys 推出一项已可商用的互操作方案，连接星展银行代币服务与 Kinexys 基于账户的许可型代币化存款体系。机构客户可在美国与新加坡的区块链账户之间全天候进行即时美元转账，覆盖周末及传统银行营业时间之外。

官方称，这是首个此类跨境代币化存款互操作方案。蚂蚁国际成为首家使用该方案进行实时全球资金管理的客户。公告称，该方案落实了双方 2025 年 11 月公布的互操作框架，并由双方作为创始股东的结算基础设施 Partior 负责结算编排。该进展也服务于新加坡金融管理局主导的行业倡议 Project BLOOM，星展银行与 Kinexys 共同牵头其中的代币互操作工作组。

公告同时注明，Kinexys 区块链存款账户网络上的转账可按全天候、当日完成；但从传统活期存款账户调入或调出该网络，目前每周六美国东部时间 15:00 至 18:00 仍有 3 小时暂停，相关升级正在开发中。蚂蚁国际与两家银行在账户型代币化存款领域已有合作：2024 年曾参与星展银行 Treasury Tokens 方案上线，也是亚洲较早接入 Kinexys 区块链存款账户网络的机构之一。公告援引 Money20/20 与 FXC Intelligence 2026 年 4 月的报告称，亚洲对外跨境支付规模预计将由 2025 年的 13.5 万亿美元增至 2033 年的 24 万亿美元。88% 的受访企业已在部署或试点代币化货币相关用例。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes
Aster’s CEO attributed the extreme volatility to highly leveraged liquidations but said the exchange remained operational.
Aster CEO Leonard Leung says the team is investigating a sharp swing in its ASTER token after a volatile trading session that sent the price above $0.71 before crashing back to $0.48 in just over 15 minutes.
Leung attributed the volatility to liquidations of highly leveraged positions, which he said were “likely malicious,” although the team was still investigating the incident.
Leung also said Aster’s operations were functioning normally and that the episode was unrelated to ASTER market-making arrangements.
The token later recovered to around $0.55, up 4.5% over the previous 24 hours but still roughly 22.5% below its intraday peak.
The swings came alongside heavy derivatives trading. CoinGlass recorded about $1.29 billion in ASTER futures volume over 24 hours, up 121% from the day before, while 24-hour spot volume was $118.3 million, up 67% from the day before.
Meanwhile, tracked liquidations totaled approximately $9.1 million, including $5.97 million in long positions and $3.14 million in shorts.
ASTER is the native token of Aster, a decentralized exchange offering leveraged perpetual futures trading. The token supports governance and community rewards, while the protocol uses a portion of its revenue to buy back ASTER.
Related: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
items.title: Aster CEO suspects foul play after token plunges 32% in minutes

【Vitalik：EIP-8037 拟通过提高状态创建成本缓解状态增长瓶颈】

Foresight News 消息，Vitalik 发布文章称，EIP-8037 旨在通过提高新建状态（账户、存储槽、代码）的 Gas 成本，反映其对网络的实际负担，从而在尽量减少状态规模增长的前提下提升执行容量。提案引入状态 Gas Reservoir 机制，允许单笔交易超出 16.7M Gas 限制执行大规模操作。该方案与 EIP-8038（提高状态 I/O 成本）、EIP-7976（Calldata 最低成本）等配合，可实现安全扩容而不损害去中心化与安全性。此外，Vitalik 指出状态规模增长是当前主要瓶颈，执行与 Calldata 扩容相对可控，并提及通过 EIP-8141 等缓解应用兼容性问题，提醒开发者 Gas 定价等协议参数可能调整。

Luxor遭AI攻击，超12个客户账户算力被转移，漏洞已修复

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，比特币矿业基础设施公司 Luxor Technology 表示，其矿机管理软件 Commander 周末遭遇 AI 赋能攻击，导致超过 12 个客户账户的算力被未经授权地转移至其他矿池。

Luxor 称，团队于周六发现异常后，工程人员在两小时内修复漏洞，并开始将受影响矿机恢复至原有矿池设置。公司表示，此次事件未造成数据泄露或外传，计划对受影响客户的算力损失进行全额赔偿。目前 Commander 已恢复正常运行，其他服务未受影响，用户无需采取额外措施。

Luxor CEO Nick Hansen 表示，目前各类企业，尤其是加密行业企业，正面临大量 AI 赋能攻击，公司已采取主动防御措施，并购置自有 GPU 运行模型以提升安全能力。

此前，Luxor 于 10 月完成 1600 万美元战略融资，由 CMT Digital 领投，Canaan、MicroBT 等参与。该公司今年 9 月还推出 Luxor AI，将业务从比特币挖矿基础设施拓展至 AI 和高性能计算领域。

items.content:
Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings
The weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6%.
Asian semiconductor stocks slid on Monday ahead of Nvidia’s quarterly earnings, with analysts set to look for signs that the AI spending boom remains on track amid uncertainty over the chipmaker’s leadership and future growth.
Japanese chip-testing equipment maker Advantest (6857:TYO) dropped about 10.4%, semiconductor inspection equipment maker Lasertec (6920:TYO) declined more than 10.7% and chipmaking equipment supplier Tokyo Electron (8035:TYO) fell 5.7%, according to Google Finance.
South Korean memory-chip makers Samsung Electronics (005930:KRX) and SK Hynix (000660:KRX) lost 5.8% and 4.2%, respectively, while Taiwanese chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330:TPE) slipped 3.8%.
The broad decline could reflect caution toward AI-linked stocks ahead of Nvidia’s results, although the weakness came amid a wider sell-off in regional equity markets, with Japan’s Nikkei 225 down 2% and South Korea’s Kospi losing 2.6% as of 4:04 am UTC.
What analysts are looking for during Nvidia investor call
Nvidia is scheduled to release its fiscal third-quarter results on Tuesday, followed by an earnings call. The results will be Nvidia’s first since founder Jensen Huang resigned as CEO.
Investors and analysts will be looking at how Nvidia will respond to the AI demand boom while its leadership is in turmoil. Morningstar on Friday said it will be looking to see whether the mid-term elections have led to any concern about future demand and whether Nvidia’s outlook for the industry has changed.
In August, Nvidia forecast fiscal third-quarter revenue of $108 billion, plus or minus 2%, excluding any data center compute revenue from China.
Related: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
Analysts expect Nvidia to report slightly higher quarterly revenue of $109.3 billion, including $101.8 billion from its data center business, according to Visible Alpha consensus figures published by S&P Global Market Intelligence on Thursday.
S&P Global said revenue expectations had risen since the previous quarter on anticipated strength in Nvidia’s Blackwell chips.
Morningstar analysts also said they expect another “beat-and-raise quarter” out of Nvidia, given strong capex trends among hyperscalers and enterprises.
“We’d be stunned if Nvidia provided an earnings miss or weak forecast,” they said.
Nvidia shares closed Friday down 2.01% at $162.85, according to Google Finance.
Magazine: US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest
items.title: Asian chip stocks tumble ahead of Nvidia Q3 earnings

AI基建股自6月以来蒸发4.2万亿美元，「卖铲」交易遭遇逆转

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，全球制造、公用事业及矿业企业自今年 6 月以来市值合计蒸发 4.2 万亿美元，几乎抹去此前一年相关板块 9.4 万亿美元涨幅的一半。此前受益于 AI 数据中心建设热潮的「卖铲」企业正遭遇集中抛售，工业板块已成为今夏以来标普 500 指数表现第二差的板块，仅次于科技板块。

其中，数据中心燃气发电设备供应商卡特彼勒自 6 月底历史高点以来下跌 44%，市值缩水约 214 亿美元；核电企业 Oklo 股价下跌 49%，暖通空调制造商 Comfort Systems 及光纤制造商康宁同期市值也损失约一半。

分析人士认为，此前大量机构资金涌入 AI 基建交易，推高了部分传统工业企业的估值，投资者将其当作半导体成长股定价，导致市场出现过度乐观。美国中期选举后，数据中心建设监管政策的不确定性也加剧了抛售压力。

不过，行业基本面尚未明显转弱。卡特彼勒积压订单创纪录地达到 780 亿美元，发电业务销售额同比增长 75%；西门子数据中心电气设备订单积压增长 60%，达到 70 亿欧元；伊顿相关订单同比翻倍。部分企业预计，现有积压订单至少能够支撑营收增长至 2027 年。

市场分歧在于，高企的订单积压能否持续转化为实际需求。部分分析人士警告，企业可能存在重复下单、超额预订等现象，订单数据未必完全反映真实需求。此次调整或意味着市场正在重新评估 AI 基建企业的估值，而非单纯押注数据中心建设热潮已经结束。

DeepSeek算力吃紧：长对话、单次输入、每日使用量开始全面受限，疑似酝酿付费套餐

动察 Beating AI 快讯，DeepSeek 开始限制免费聊天服务。多名用户发现，DeepSeek App 和网页端不再支持超过 7 天未互动的长对话。单次输入上限缩短至约 4 万字，每日对话也开始设置额度，用完后会提示「因服务器繁忙，使用额度已达上限」。

前两天就有开发者发现，DeepSeek 网页前端新增了一整套额度管理代码。它能每隔 5 分钟同步各模型的剩余额度，并在额度耗尽后显示提醒。代码还出现了名为「Coding Plan」的套餐，引发了 DeepSeek 即将推出个人付费订阅的猜测。

DeepSeek 刚在 11 月 13 日开放了联网搜索、文件读取、语音等应用 API，还开源了支持导入历史对话的演示客户端。受到影响的用户可以导出原有聊天记录，再通过这个客户端导入并继续对话，API 调用按实际用量付费。

目前，DeepSeek 尚未公布具体的每日使用额度，也没有确认 Coding Plan 的价格或上线日期。

特朗普政府拟将英伟达列入AI「国家领军企业」名单，可获芯片出口快速审批

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据知情人士透露，英伟达将成为二十多家被指定为人工智能「国家冠军」的公司之一，这是特朗普政府为帮助 AI 企业在海外赢得业务而采取的一项举措。知情人士称，该消息预计将在下周公布，这表明尽管英伟达目前面临动荡，特朗普政府仍将在其科技战略上全速推进。

「国家冠军」倡议旨在促使外国企业和国家采用美国的 AI 技术。根据美国商务部该项目的网站介绍，获得「国家冠军」称号的企业可以获得芯片出口许可的快速审批、政府对其海外业务的支持，以及获取联邦融资的渠道。该计划大约在一年前首次公布，但当时并未公布「国家冠军」的具体名单。

知情人士透露，即将被指定为「国家冠军」的企业包括英伟达、亚马逊、微软、OpenAI 和 Anthropic。该计划的目标是将美国的芯片、模型和其他 AI 产品进行打包，以便其他国家的客户能够轻松地将它们打包购买。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377492

黄仁勋丑闻曝光前，英伟达董事套现9.47亿美元，如今股价从高点跌32%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，英伟达董事 Mark Stevens 在黄仁勋丑闻曝光前，卖出了近 10 亿美元股票，恰好躲过随后的一轮大跌。

根据美国 SEC 文件，Stevens 在今年 8 月 31 日至 9 月 18 日期间，通过与妻子共同管理的家族信托，分三批出售约 424 万股英伟达股票，合计套现 9.47 亿美元，约合人民币 63 亿元。

英伟达股价随后在 10 月 6 日创下 239.24 美元的收盘高点。随着黄仁勋丑闻发酵，并于 11 月 12 日辞去 CEO 职务，股价一路下跌。11 月 13 日收于 162.85 美元，较高点下跌 31.9%，较 Stevens 的平均卖价低了 27.1%。

引人注意的是，三份 SEC 申报均未注明这些交易按照 Rule 10b5-1 预设交易计划执行。这项制度允许公司内部人士提前安排卖股时间和数量，以降低内幕交易的法律风险。

相比之下，英伟达首席财务官、现任临时 CEO Colette Kress，以及总法律顾问 Tim Teter 此前的卖股交易，都注明了预设交易计划。

Stevens 并未清仓。截至最后一次申报，他仍持有约 2753 万股英伟达股票。

ASTER Swings Over 30%; Aster CEO Says Volatility Is Unrelated to Market Making, Investigates Leveraged Liquidations

ASTER briefly surged above $0.71 to a high of $0.7124 earlier today before plunging to around $0.4812, a roughly 32% decline from peak to trough. ASTER is now trading at $0.5464, up 3.80% over the past 24 hours.

Aster CEO Leonard said the team is investigating abnormal ASTER price movements caused by liquidations of highly leveraged positions, potentially involving malicious activity. Full details will follow in subsequent reports. He added that Aster is operating normally, the incident is unrelated to ASTER market making, and the platform has no such arrangements with any market makers. — link

无法接受黄仁勋离开，英伟达机器人研究工程师宣布辞职

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，英伟达机器人研究工程师 Darrell Dai 昨日发布公开信称已决定辞职。其表示，「作为英伟达的一名机器人工程师，我眼中的黄仁勋，远不止是公司的首席执行官。我敬佩他愿意为尚不明朗的未来投入资源。早在深度学习热潮到来之前，他就坚定地押注 CUDA，并在人工智能成为所有人的优先事项之前，就为英伟达布局了这一领域。这些决策帮助构建了支撑当今人工智能的基础设施。」

关于离职原因，Darrell Dai 称「我并不掌握与指控有关的全部事实，也无法对调查结果预先作出判断。我对黄仁勋的敬佩，并不意味着他可以免受审视。我难以接受的是，在得到有助于我理解的解释之前，就不得不接受他离开的事实。这对我来说，意味着我们的方向、我们的文化，以及那些实际开展工作的人，都将面临怎样的变化，目前仍不清楚。」

黄仁勋被曝想重掌英伟达：硅谷大佬帮忙游说，近17万人撑腰

动察 Beating AI 快讯，据《金融时报》报道，黄仁勋已和身边人谈过回去继续当 CEO 的事。一名盟友透露，他们正召集硅谷高管，准备成立一个专门推动黄仁勋复职的「战情室」，游说英伟达董事会，还打算争取白宫支持。

这名人士说：「除了那些前沿 AI 实验室，科技圈里有头有脸的人都喜欢黄仁勋。」他还透露，黄仁勋本人也支持这场复职行动。不过，黄仁勋尚未亲自公开表态。

支持者发起的 Stand with Jensen 联署网站也越来越热闹，签名已经飙升至 16.7 万份。其中约 8200 人自称英伟达现任员工，接近公司员工总数的五分之一。

Qwen4-Max正式发布：主干规模不变，激活参数减少25%，任务成本下降62%

动察 Beating AI 快讯，继上周开放预览版后，阿里正式发布新一代旗舰模型 Qwen4-Max，公布完整技术架构、评测成绩及 API 定价。

Qwen4-Max 延续上一代 2.4 万亿参数的主干规模，额外引入 3280 亿 N-gram Embedding 参数。通过重新设计注意力机制、残差连接和词组嵌入层，每次生成 Token 激活的主干参数从约 950 亿降至 710 亿，减少约 25%。模型支持原生视觉理解和 100 万 Token 上下文。

官方评测显示，Qwen4-Max 在专业工作基准 Work360 上获得 52.69 分，上一代为 47.74 分。这套阿里自建的评测覆盖金融、法律、制造业等专业任务。在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 编程测试中，新模型的 Token 消耗比上一代减少约 48% 至 49%。Work360 的平均单任务成本则从 4.43 美元降至 1.67 美元，下降 62%。

阿里还展示了一个科研案例。Qwen4 联合自动化实验平台，连续自主运行 48 小时，从 270 万个候选分子中筛选适用于数据中心的新型冷却液材料。经过四轮分子设计、实验合成和测试，最终制出了经过实验验证的候选分子实物样品。不过，官方尚未披露足以证明其实际冷却效果优于现有材料的数据。

在汽车制造案例中，Qwen4-Max 参与零件建模、加工路径规划和仿真验证。一项工件加工编程任务的人工操作时间，从约 475 分钟缩短至 24 分钟，减少约 95%。模型还能使用 Blender、Unreal Engine 和 Unity，制作 3D 场景、可玩游戏，并根据运行反馈反复修改。

Qwen4-Max 已开放正式 API，支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口。每百万 Token 输入 10 元、输出 30 元，比上一代便宜约 17%；缓存命中输入价格从 1.5 元降至 0.5 元。

阿里确认后续会开源 Qwen4 系列的较小模型。

不过合众银行表示，FOMC 整体似乎仍倾向于采取更为稳健的紧缩步伐, 仍预计美联储将在 12 月加息 25 个基点，并于明年 3 月再次加息 25 个基点，同时认为 12 月加息 50 个基点虽然存在可能性，但发生的概率仍相对较低。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Felix Ng
items.content:
Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack
Attackers redirected customers’ Bitcoin mining power through Luxor’s Commander platform over the weekend, prompting its CEO to issue a warning to crypto businesses.
Bitcoin mining services provider Luxor has warned that AI-enabled cyberattacks are becoming increasingly difficult to defend against after attackers compromised its mining-management platform and redirected customers’ computing power to another mining pool over the weekend.
In an X post on Sunday, Luxor CEO Nick Hansen said the attack came through a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector,” without specifying how AI was used in the attack, warning that these types of attacks will only get more frequent over time.
“At this moment, anyone running any sort of substantial business, especially in crypto, is inundated with AI-enabled attacks,” Hansen said in an X post. “This does not seem to be slowing down; rather, it’s speeding up as models get better and more attackers enter the arena.”
The warning comes as security researchers have documented the spread of AI-assisted hacking tools, raising the prospect of faster attacks against businesses holding money or controlling valuable infrastructure.
“Abliterated models are running 24/7 against your entire surface, looking for a little crack, which they then use to (almost instantly) expand,” added Hansen.
Hansen said Luxor has had to put the majority of its feature work on hold in order to harden its cybersecurity. The company has also acquired its own GPUs to run unrestricted open-weight AI models aimed at improving its security posture.
“I urge anyone running a similar service to do the same. It’s your only defense in this new AI-powered dark forest. ‘The only thing that stops a bad guy with a gun is a good guy with a gun.’”
Bitcoin miners hijacked
Initial reports suggested that about 64,000 mining machines representing 13 exahashes per second were redirected to the OCEAN mining pool on Saturday.
Luxor has not confirmed either figure, saying the incident affected just over a dozen customer accounts using its Commander mining-management tool.
Luxor said it patched Commander within two hours of detecting the unauthorized changes and began restoring affected machines to their original pool settings. It pledged to compensate customers in full for the redirected mining power and publish a post-mortem.
Cointelegraph contacted Luxor for comment.
Related: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
“We have explored the issue extensively, and it was isolated to the Commander tool. None of Luxor’s other services (including Luxor Pool and LuxOS) were affected,” said Luxor.
Initial reports suggested the attackers received no mining rewards. However, a Bitcoin address identified by CoreX as associated with the incident subsequently received two OCEAN payouts totaling approximately 0.162 BTC, worth about $10,500.
AI-assisted attacks on the rise
Hansen’s warning follows a string of reported AI-assisted intrusions targeting crypto businesses.
Earlier this month, India’s cybersecurity agency warned that a group called Crafty Falcon was using AI-powered tools to attack financial companies, including cryptocurrency exchanges, stealing wallet keys and siphoning funds.
Blockchain analytics firm Chainalysis disclosed in October that an attacker used what it called “offensive agentic techniques” to access its systems. The breach exposed password hashes, live tokens and other customer information.
Anthropic said in a September report that multiple groups had developed “automated exploit foundries” with AI, accelerating the pace of vulnerability research, testing, and exploit design.

items.title: Luxor CEO warns of AI ‘dark forest’ following Bitcoin miner hijack

Despite BTC’s ~30% drop since October, exchange inflows show no panic: Binance’s monthly average rose from ~1,200 to 2,100 BTC, with over 9,000 BTC on Nov 3 alone—still below June and February peaks. The figures may include Binance hack-related transfers or UTXO consolidations. — link

美银：美元正成为全球市场「破坏之球」，建议维持避险立场至明年春季

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，美国银行首席投资策略师 Michael Hartnett 在最新一期《Flow Show》报告中表示，美元持续走强正在收紧全球流动性，压制风险资产及大宗商品，当前市场处于「追涨有风险、做空有壁垒」的两难局面，因此建议投资者继续保持避险立场。

Hartnett 指出，美元指数上周五收于 103.42，创年内新高。他将风险资产重新入场的条件设定为 WTI 原油跌破 70 美元、10 年期美债收益率降至 4.5% 以下，以及美元开始走弱，但目前三项条件均未满足。他因此将美元见顶时间预期推迟至明年 2 至 3 月，并将风险资产的入场窗口延后至明年春季。

此外，Hartnett 认为，美联储紧缩政策尚未结束、政府干预限制市场下跌空间，以及美国高净值群体消费保持韧性，共同加剧了市场的复杂性。他还警告，若标普 500 指数跌破 7000 点，美元流动性收紧及央行在经济放缓时继续加息可能成为主要风险；若突破 8000 点，则可能意味着风险偏好进一步回升。

观点：比特币下跌期间未平仓合约降幅有限，市场杠杆风险可能尚未出清

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Bitfinex 发文表示，比特币从 83,000 美元跌至 74,000 美元期间，市场未平仓合约（OI）几乎没有变化，意味着下跌过程中仍有更多资金进入杠杆仓位。

而当比特币进一步跌至约 65,000 美元时，未平仓合约规模仅与价格同步下降，并未出现更大幅度的收缩。

在未平仓合约降幅明显超过价格跌幅之前，市场此前积累的杠杆仓位可能仍未充分出清，潜在去杠杆压力依然存在。

美股期货小幅上涨，市场聚焦英伟达财报与Anthropic IPO

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据 BIT 股票平台数据显示，美股股指期货小幅上涨，纳指 100 期货涨 0.43%，标普 500 指数期货涨 0.21%，道指期货涨 0.04%。市场正为本周两大重磅事件做准备：英伟达财报及 Anthropic IPO。

英伟达将于周二美股盘后公布财报。分析师预计，公司营收和利润同比增幅均接近 100%，但市场更关注公司在黄仁勋辞去 CEO 职务后如何稳定管理层，以及临时 CEO Colette Kress 能否通过财报和电话会议重建投资者信心。受黄仁勋离职风波影响，英伟达上周累计下跌 13%，创 2025 年 4 月以来最大单周跌幅。

另一大焦点是 Anthropic IPO。该公司目前瞄准约 1.4 万亿美元估值，预计发行价区间为每股 70 至 78 美元，有望成为史上规模最大的 IPO 之一。

尽管英伟达上周大幅下跌，美股整体仍录得单周上涨。

items.author: theblockbeats
items.content:
亚洲投资者抢购Anthropic间接持股机会，部分基金份额溢价高达30%

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，随着 Anthropic 即将启动 IPO，亚洲高净值投资者及家族办公室正通过离岸基金、特殊目的载体（SPV）等方式抢购其间接持股机会，部分投资者甚至愿意为相关基金份额支付最高 30% 的溢价。

由于 Anthropic 等硅谷大型未上市公司严格限制股权转让，投资者通常无法直接持有其股份，只能通过持有底层资产的基金或多层投资载体获得经济敞口。一家正在向亚洲及中东家族办公室募资的基金披露，其投资组合约 17% 配置于 Anthropic、11% 配置于 OpenAI，均通过二级市场渠道获得。

部分持有 Anthropic 间接敞口的投资者也正趁 IPO 前出售基金份额。一名香港投资者计划以约 9650 亿美元估值出售部分持仓，并要求买方支付超过 20% 的溢价。另有投资者此前通过投资银行转让相关基金份额时，溢价曾达到 100% 至 200%。

不过，相关投资也面临估值、流动性及结构风险。Anthropic 的预期估值已从此前的 2 万亿美元降至约 1.4 万亿美元，部分基金还可能在 IPO 后设置超过通常 180 天的锁定期。Anthropic 此前也曾警告，间接投资基金可能通过规避公司股权转让限制的方式提供投资机会，并提醒投资者自行承担风险。

此外，散户也在通过其他渠道押注 Anthropic。Talos 数据显示，Entropy、TradeXYZ 及 OKX 等平台上的 Anthropic IPO 前永续合约未平仓合约规模已超过 2.6 亿美元；部分 ETF 则通过 SPV 持有 Anthropic 股份，例如 Tema Photonics & Optical ETF 对 Anthropic 的间接配置比例约为 12.7%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377462
items.title: 亚洲投资者抢购Anthropic间接持股机会，部分基金份额溢价高达30%

items.content:
某交易员称通过监控BitGo代码变更及Wintermute链上活动，预测Robinhood Meme币上线获利超600万美元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，化名为 @3i 的交易员称，其团队通过监控 BitGo 公开代码库及 Wintermute 在 Robinhood Chain 上的链上活动，提前发现 Robinhood 即将上线 Meme 币的线索，并通过抢先买入 Cash Cat 和 PONS 两种代币获利超过 600 万美元。

具体而言，BitGo 开发者于 7 月 27 日在公开 GitHub 仓库提交代码变更，为 Robinhood Chain 上的 Cash Cat 添加支持，并于次日合并。Robinhood 随后于 8 月 6 日正式上线该代币。交易员称，其团队在发现代码变更后持续追踪 Wintermute 钱包，并于 8 月 3 日监测到 Wintermute 批准 Cash Cat 交易池，随后大举买入，持仓一度达到代币总供应量的约 4%。

链上数据显示，一个被 Bubblemaps 标记的钱包于 8 月 3 日买入约 1,500 万枚 Cash Cat，占总供应量约 1.5%，累计买入金额约 110 万美元。Robinhood 于 8 月 6 日宣布上线该代币后，交易员称团队通过高位出售获利超过 400 万美元。此外，该团队还通过提前买入 PONS 获利约 200 万美元。

已核实部分公开代码记录及链上交易时间线，但无法独立验证交易员声称的盈利金额及相关钱包归属。报道还指出，PONS 此前的一次疑似上线交易可能是 Robinhood 用于识别内部交易者的诱饵，而美国司法部已于 9 月 15 日起诉两名前 Robinhood 工程师，指控其利用未公开的代币上线信息提前交易。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377461
items.title: 某交易员称通过监控BitGo代码变更及Wintermute链上活动，预测Robinhood Meme币上线获利超600万美元

以媒：美国目前无意仓促对伊朗采取军事行动

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据以色列 i24News，消息人士透露，尽管以色列正推动恢复对伊朗的军事行动，但美国近期似乎不会立即对伊朗发动新一轮空袭。以色列消息人士表示，以色列摩萨德局长戈夫曼在访问华盛顿期间，向美国高级官员通报了伊朗近期重新加强军事建设的最新情报。

不过该人士补充说：「归根结底，美国有一位总统，他会根据自己的考量作出决定。目前看来，局势并没有朝着恢复空袭的方向发展。美国并不急于采取行动。」一名美国消息人士证实：「在可预见的极短期内，发动袭击似乎并未列入议程，但这一情况随时可能发生变化。」

以色列消息人士表示，以色列国内的政治发展并未影响特朗普的决策考量。相反，特朗普正在权衡两个方面：一是能否在此前两轮战事的基础上取得决定性成果，二是新一届美国国会将于明年 1 月履职之前的政治时间安排。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，2023 年，Anthropic CEO 阿莫代伊在比佛利山庄与演员出身的风险投资家阿什顿·库彻、音乐经纪人盖伊·奥塞里会面，讨论 AI 安全、模型研发竞争及公司愿景。会后，库彻和奥塞里决定通过旗下 Sound Ventures 参与 Anthropic 首轮由机构领投的融资。

据知情人士透露，Sound Ventures 累计向 Anthropic 投资 4.35 亿美元，目前持股约 0.5%。按 Anthropic 计划 IPO 的 1.4 万亿美元估值计算，其股权价值约 70 亿美元，较投资成本增长约 1500%。

值得注意的是，Sound Ventures 此前已投资 OpenAI，而当时风投行业普遍避免投资现有被投企业的竞争对手。奥塞里表示，库彻获得 OpenAI 首席执行官奥尔特曼的许可后，公司才推进对 Anthropic 的投资。

Jensen Huang weighs Nvidia comeback days after shock exit: FT
Silicon Valley executives are reportedly organizing a campaign to bring Huang back and are looking to gain White House support.
Jensen Huang is reportedly considering a return as Nvidia CEO just days after resigning from the company following reports of affairs with a suspected Chinese spy and a subordinate.
Huang has discussed with confidants the possibility of returning to Nvidia, according to the Financial Times, citing multiple people familiar with the matter. One source told the FT they were putting together a “war room” of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for Nvidia’s chief’s return, and are looking to gain support from the White House.
“Everyone that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen,” they said.
Meanwhile, a public campaign called “Bring Jensen Back” has attracted more than 161,000 signatures, according to its organizers, who list Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney among its supporters. The campaign website also claims to have over 9,000 signatures from current and former Nvidia employees.
The push for his return goes against calls for new leadership at the AI chipmaker and coincides with an independent board investigation and scrutiny of its chip sales to Asia.
Related: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had third alleged affair: Reuters
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent on Sunday called for a “dramatic shake-up” of Nvidia’s leadership, urging the company to hire a CEO from outside the company, while President Donald Trump suggested Thursday that former Apple CEO Tim Cook take the job.
Nvidia announced Huang’s resignation Thursday following reports of alleged extramarital relationships, including one involving a woman whom US intelligence officials reportedly suspected of having ties to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia’s board has launched an independent investigation into his conduct.
The controversy has also raised questions about Nvidia’s compliance with US restrictions on AI chip sales, particularly involving customers in Asia with potential ties to China.
Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% on Thursday before recovering to close 4.3% lower, underscoring investor uncertainty over the AI chipmaker’s future leadership.
Cointelegraph reached out to Nvidia for comment.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Andrew Fenton
items.content:
US sellers drive Bitcoin crash, Jensen plots Nvidia comeback: Hodler’s Digest
Anchorage Digital data suggests the Bitcoin selloff is being driven by US investors. A “war room” has been set up by supporters to reinstate Nvidia boss Jensen Huang.
Bitcoin bottomed after the US midterm elections in 2018 and 2022 — and the great Bitcoin crash of November 2026 looks like history repeating. Bitcoin plunged more than $10,000 this week, and is currently trading at $65,116 for a 12.4% loss.
According to Anchorage Digital researcher David Lawant, the call is coming from inside the house. “BTC sell pressure continues to come primarily from the U.S,” he noted, positing a chart highlighting showing continued heavy net taker sell flow primarily on Coinbase compared with overseas exchanges.
The US spot Bitcoin ETFs have seen heavy outflows, losing $2.35 billion over the past two weeks, and influencer Axel Bitblaze noted that Bitcoin fell in the hour before the US open on all but two of the past fifteen days.
Source: Anchorage Digital
Binance founder Changpeng Zhao also rebuffed the idea that Binance is behind the crash. “No, Binance did not sell crypto. I bought crypto in the past few days,” he said. He attributed the crash to money shifting to the Anthropic IPO, the Bitcoin ETF outflows, security fears about crypto in general in the wake of the Binance hack, and hot inflation data raising expectations of interest rate hikes. Markets are now pricing in a quarter point Fed hike in December.
Bitcoin fell to a four month low near $62,000 on Sunday but has since rebounded above $65,000. The Crypto Fear and Greed Index fell to 10, which is Extreme Fear.
History provides some good news in that Bitcoin more then doubled in price within 12 months of the 2018 and 2022 midterm elections.
Jensen discusses Nvidia comeback days after resigning
The Financial Times reports that Jensen Huang is plotting a comeback to the top job at Nvidia with allies, following a determined push in Silicon Valley to pressure the board to reinstate him.
Nvidia shares plunged after Huang resigned as CEO and from the board on Nov. 12, with Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress named as interim CEO. The resignation came shortly after news broke he’d had two other affairs, including one with a subordinate.
Multiple people confirmed Huang has been discussing the idea of returning with confidants, even though an independent probe by the board is examining allegations he was romantically involved with a Chinese spy who helped ferry chips to China.
The FT reported one ally saying that supporters have put together a “war room” to reinstate him. “Everybody that matters in tech outside the frontier labs loves Jensen,” the source said.
A petition to reinstate Huang has garnered more than 100,000 signatures, including 5,600 current Nvidia employees, along with SpaceX boss Elon Musk and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney.
The turmoil at Nvidia has weighed heavily on AI stocks and risk assets like cryptocurrency and the story still has a long way to run, with Congressional moves to investigate the issue and three bills being advanced to tighten AI chip export restrictions to China. According to the New York Time, intelligence officials reportedly briefed President Trump about the allegations Alice Huang was a Chinese spy a year ago, but he did not take any action.
Ethereum should become post-quantum in 2027: Ethlabs
Ethereum research group Ethlabs is withdrawing its Quick Slots proposal from the forthcoming Hegotá upgrade, and has urged core developers to urgently prepare the network for quantum attacks by 2027.
On Wednesday, the group outlined “pqai27,” a proposed roadmap that aims to protect Ethereum against threats from quantum computing and artificial intelligence.
At Devcon, researcher Justin Drake said he hopes to complete the transition in 2028 while the published roadmap still targets December 2029.
Strategy gets booted from MSCI indexes
Index provider MSCI has confirmed Bitcoin treasury company Strategy will be removed from its global equity indexes, following months of debate over whether crypto treasury firms qualify as operating businesses. Japan’s Metaplanet and crypto treasury company Upexi are also marked for deletion, while Ether treasury firm Sharplink is on a watchlist. The changes take effect after market close on Nov. 30.
“Index inclusion meant ordinary passive investors, like someone holding a global index fund in their pension, were getting leveraged Bitcoin exposure they never chose. MSCI just fixed that,” Ryan Kirkley, CEO of Global Settlement Network, told Cointelegraph. Strategy fell 6.49% on Thursday and are down by more than one quarter over the past month.
Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in 2 weeks, BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded $2.35 billion in net outflows over two consecutive weeks, as redemptions reached more than $1 billion each week.
According to Farside Investors data, spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.07 billion between from Monday to Friday, following $1.28 billion in outflows the previous week, the largest weekly redemptions since late June.
Friday marked the seventh consecutive trading session of net withdrawals, with about $1.71 billion redeemed since Nov. 5
Winners and Losers
At the end of the week, Bitcoin (BTC) is down 12.4% to trade at $65,116, Ethereum (ETH) is down 14.4% to trade at $1,822 and XRP (XRP) is down 13.3% to $0.96. The total market cap is at $2.2 trillion according to CoinMarketCap.
Among the biggest 100 cryptocurrencies, the top three altcoin winners of the week are Kite (KITE) with a 35.5% gain, Pieverse (PIEVERSE) on 33.8%, and Midnight (CRV) on 28.7%.
The top three altcoin losers of the week are Zcash (ZEC) which was down 25.4%, Uniswap (UNI) down 23.2% and Aero (AERO) down 23.1%.
Prediction of the Week
Bitcoin’s ‘best buying opportunity ever’ has arrived: Mark Moss
Bitcoin Opportunity Fund co-founder Mark Moss says that with banks and ETFs widening access to Bitcoin he expects a new record high in 2027. Wall Street’s embrace of Bitcoin has created the “best buying opportunity ever,” he said.
Top FUD of the Week
Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
Microsoft managed to restore Microsoft 365 services after a massive global outage disrupted Outlook, Teams and other applications for more than 24 hours, reiterating that the disruption was not caused by a cyberattack.
Microsoft said that the outage stemmed from a problem introduced during an earlier network capacity upgrade that emerged after a recent network change. “This was a technical issue not related to cyber or AI/agents,” the company said.
MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
MEGA, the organization behind Ethereum layer-2 network MegaETH, has reduced its workforce by 20% following months of restructuring as it expands into artificial intelligence products.
The layoffs come as MEGA shifts its focus toward developing products on the MegaETH network, including artificial intelligence services. The organization has committed $30 million to the initiative.
Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
Metaplanet swung to a $170 million net loss in the first nine months of 2026, hit by a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings and a loss on the sale of 10,000 coins to demonstrate its ability to raise cash.
The Japanese company, the world’s second-largest publicly traded corporate Bitcoin (BTC) holder, posted a net loss of 27.16 billion yen (about $170 million), compared with a profit of 13.53 billion yen ($84.6 million) in the same period last year. A 19.17 billion yen ($119.8 million) loss on the Bitcoin sale and an 8.04 billion yen ($50.3 million) loss from a decline in the value of its Bitcoin holdings outweighed gains in the operating business.
Top Magazine Features of the Week
Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.
Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

--- Top Comments ---

[xp84]: Link shorteners  that are outsourced  are in my humble opinion an order of magnitude worse for the internet than they would be if in-house. The way they accrete URLs over time, and then time passes, and anything can happen (your account gets deactivated, shortener company goes out of business / experiences catastrophic data loss / etc) is just asking for permanently broken links which may be unfixable. Especially when you consider how these services can, unless they're spammy e...

[101008]: Short anecdote: Famous author (with huge fanbase!) used a Bit.ly link in one of their books (the narrative needed a fake tweet with fake link). Editor didn't notice/care and never registered it. I noticed on release date, caught it and redirected it to a website that referenced the book, a few people tweet about it thinking the author used the link on purpose!

[silisili]: I think the biggest surprise to me is that a URL shortener makes enough money to have a Trust and Safety team.  I assumed it was just a side project a person or two ran.

[cubefox]: A bigger issue perhaps than some old links now redirecting to scams is large scale link rot. The scam problem does already exist for normal links when the domain is not renewed and the new owner points it to a shady website. But link rot is a wider problem: if one link shortener ceases operations, a huge number of links will just no longer work, and it will usually no longer be possible to find out what content they were linking to, because you can't guess it from the domain name and URL...

[Alive-in-2025]: There's a lot of abandoned url ownership things on the internet. We need something like a bureau that keeps track of what it was for. We do have archive.is or .org to save the content at a url (side note - are these archivers legal or in some country that allows this?). I do often come across an article occasionally where someone is writing about a narrow topic that I'm interesting in, but I can't find them any more - maybe they had a vauge user name that isn't resolvable....

黄仁勋正与盟友讨论回归英伟达计划，硅谷高管拟组建「战情室」游说董事会

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据英国《金融时报》报道，英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋正在与亲信讨论重返公司管理层的可能性。多名硅谷科技界人士正推动英伟达董事会重新任命黄仁勋，并计划组建「战情室」，争取科技行业高管及白宫支持。

特斯拉、SpaceX CEO 马斯克和 Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney 已公开支持一封要求英伟达董事会「让黄仁勋回归」的联名信。部分英伟达员工也公开表达对黄仁勋的支持。

不过，黄仁勋回归仍面临阻力。美国财政部长 Scott Bessent 周日呼吁英伟达进行「重大领导层调整」。与此同时，英伟达董事会正在对引发此次管理层危机的相关行为展开独立调查，公司目前由临时 CEO Colette Kress 领导。

此前，黄仁勋因被曝与疑似间谍、同时也是新加坡芯片企业 Megaspeed 高管的 Alice Huang 存在婚外情而辞职，相关事件也引发外界对英伟达向亚洲客户销售 AI 芯片时合规审查机制的质疑。

此外，英伟达董事会此前已接触 Arm CEO Rene Haas，探讨其接任可能性，但董事会表示尚未启动正式遴选程序。英伟达两大股东 Altimeter Capital 创始人 Brad Gerstner 和 Atreides Management 负责人 Gavin Baker 此前也联名致信董事会，呼吁将黄仁勋回归纳入考虑范围。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377451

items.author: snirgbs
items.content:
We're a small business that sells pre-booked appointments with homeowners to local contractors, billed per appointment that actually happens.

Our first client agreed to this on a recorded call and saved his card through a $1 Stripe payment link, which we planned to use for billing later. That $1 payment went through.

A few weeks later we invoiced him $1,500 for 3 completed appointments and charged the saved card. Stripe blocked the payment. Two days after that the account was closed with this wording: payments "don't appear to have been authorized by the customer."

What happened next:

- We appealed through the Dashboard with an appeal letter, our company documents and the invoice. It was rejected the next day as an "unacceptable level of risk."

- Support told us our "business model presents a level of risk we're unable to support" and that the decision is final.

- After a Stripe employee escalated it internally, we got a short email saying Stripe still won't accept payments for our business.

In all of this, nobody asked us for the call recording, our messages with the client, or a confirmation from the client himself. As far as we know, he never disputed anything, and he has told us he is paying by bank transfer outside Stripe.

I'm not saying our setup is perfect. It's a new account, the first real charge was large compared to the $1 test, and billing a saved card later is probably what looked wrong. If there's something specific we should fix, I'll fix it.

What I'm asking:

1. Is there anyone at Stripe who can look at this with the evidence, including getting the client on a call?

2. For people who've been through this: how would you structure per-appointment billing so it doesn't look unauthorized (an invoice with a link each time, an email confirmation before each charge, something else)?

I can share the account details, the call recording and the messages with anyone from Stripe who wants to look. Thanks for reading. --- Top Comments --- [philsquared_]: This is as high risk as it comes... imagine a person bought a lemonade from you for $1 then later on you charged them $1500 because you saved their cc. That is all stripe sees. You need to not charge the $1 at all first of all because technically that is a fraudulent transaction since the customer is expecting to pay $1500 not $1501. Stripes docs literally say this by the way... you can always run an auth but that isn't my recommendation... You should be sending them payable invoices thr... [breue]: I had stripe fleece me for 4.5k - tried to complain about them on HN - they nerfed the post: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50398646 The sad part is I was one of their first customers - I helped onboard over a 70 clients for them over the years. And my top project generated them $1.6m in pure fees revenue. I even tried emailing Patrick and John - they don't care one bit. Its sad - they used to have a soul - became a ruthless/soulless company. Sorry you are dea... [didgeoridoo]: Yeah unfortunately this charge pattern could not have looked MORE like merchant fraud. The right approach would have been to use https://docs.stripe.com/payments/setup-intents and set it for off-session usage. You still might have gotten a payment hold on the first transaction until someone in risk could take a peek at your site to make sure you had all the right disclosures in place, but you probably would have kept the account. [codingdave]: I have no knowledge specific to Stripe or your case, but do I know that the pattern you just described - a small 1 dollar payment followed by a large payment - is the exact pattern that criminals use to test stolen credit cards numbers. My bank will automatically reject anything following that pattern, put a hold on my card, and call me to confirm whether or not I have my card. So yeah, if your business model calls for pattern matching with how stolen cards are used, that could very well be u... [A_D_E_P_T]: > 2. For people who've been through this: how would you structure per-appointment billing so it doesn't look unauthorized (an invoice with a link each time, an email confirmation before each charge, something else)? Have you tried simply sending invoices via Stripe? Works for me, without a hitch. And it's pretty flexible; you can do a lot to modify terms, add notes, send email notices to multiple parties, etc. If that won't work, there are payment processors who spe...
items.title: Ask HN: Stripe closed us after one $1,500 invoice and never asked for evidence

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Wall Street’s push into stablecoins has accelerated sharply, led by a 21-bank consortium committing roughly $270 million to “Project Faro.”.
- Banks and payment giants are shipping now: SoFi expanded SoFiUSD to Polygon, Anchorage’s tokens settle on Visa, Mastercard built out stablecoin tools and agent payments, and Circle pushed into Latin America.
- The GENIUS Act is the catalyst and the big banks rush in.
For years, stablecoins were crypto’s business, dominated by Tether and Circle and used mostly to trade digital assets. That era is ending.
Over the past few months, and especially the past few weeks, the biggest names in traditional finance have moved en masse to claim a piece of the onchain dollar. Here’s the map of a land grab that’s accelerating fast.
The bank consortium puts money down
The clearest signal came this week, when Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Santander, and Deutsche Bank were reported to be among banks committing roughly $270 million to a joint dollar-stablecoin venture codenamed “Project Faro.”
The capital funds five years of operations for a U.S.-incorporated issuer targeting a 2027 launch, part of a 21-institution coalition that has swelled from an initial group of 10. The goal is explicit: challenge Tether and Circle, which together still control about 85% of a roughly $290 billion market.
SoFi and the national-bank play
While the consortium plans, SoFi has shipped. Earlier this week, its SoFiUSD, billed as the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, expanded onto Polygon this month alongside Ethereum and Solana, reaching the bank’s 17 million-plus members.
SoFi also launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% yield that converts into SoFiUSD, and already settles its entire card program over Mastercard’s network.
Meanwhile, the federally chartered crypto bank Anchorage Digital has positioned itself as a settlement backbone.
Anchorage’s tokens can now settle transactions on Visa’s network, starting with Western Union’s USDPT, and it recently anchored both sides of the U.S.-Mexico stablecoin corridor, custodying tokens across one of the world’s largest remittance routes.
The card networks go all-in
Mastercard has been the most aggressive incumbent among payment giants.
It launched a Global Money Platform with acquired stablecoin firm BVNK, rolled out a Stablecoin Security tool to screen payments for fraud, and unveiled Agent Pay for Machines, letting AI agents transact in stablecoins.
Visa, meanwhile, has expanded its own stablecoin settlement program across multiple blockchains.
The crypto-native incumbents, not to be left out, are also racing to entrench.
Circle struck a deal to bring USDC settlement to banking rails in Latin America, starting with a Colombia pilot, part of a broader expansion into dozens of emerging markets.
Why now?
The catalyst is regulation. The GENIUS Act, signed in 2025, created the first U.S. framework for dollar-pegged tokens, giving regulated institutions a clear path into a business they had largely watched from the sidelines.
The Donald Trump administration has framed dollar stablecoins as a tool to extend the dollar’s reach and global hegemony, and banks that once dismissed crypto now see a settlement business they can’t afford to cede.
Much of this remains early. Project Faro has no token, no CEO, and no final name. Tether and Circle still dominate, and bank-issued tokens face a steep climb to win share.
But the direction is unmistakable: the onchain dollar, once crypto’s turf, is now contested ground, with Wall Street, the card networks and the stablecoin incumbents all racing to own the rails money moves on.

黄仁勋回归请愿人数突破15万大关，马斯克、Tom Lee等知名公众人物已公开支持

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，要求英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋职务的请愿网站热度仍在持续上升，截至目前，该网站已有 151,083 人签署请愿，要求黄仁勋回归，其中包括 7380 名现任员工、1381 名前任员工和 80,205 名股东等。马斯克、Tom Lee、Replit CEO Amjad Masad 等知名公众人物均已公开签名请愿。

此前 2026 年 11 月 12 日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去首席执行官职务，即刻生效。此举标志着他领导这家联合创立公司 33 年历程的结束。

本次活动组织者和签名者担心，黄仁勋可能在未经正当程序、甚至没有足够时间为自己申辩的情况下被迫离职，因此要求董事会作出解释。公开信核心诉求，致英伟达董事会：在独立调查查明事实期间，恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务；如需继续离任，请提供有证据支持的解释。确保调查独立、公开范围与时间表，并给予黄仁勋公平申辩机会。及时作出公开说明，解释相关疑虑、证据及对员工和股东利益的权衡。

信件强调：「三十三年的领导不意味着免于问责，但问责需要证据和正当程序，而非群体公审。」网站声明该活动独立，未获英伟达或黄仁勋本人背书。

【约 6.4 万台比特币矿机遭劫持，13 EH/s 算力被导向 OCEAN 矿池】

Foresight News 消息，据 Bitcoin News 监测，约 6.4 万台比特币矿机据报遭劫持，涉及 13 EH/s 算力，矿机算力被导向 OCEAN 矿池，收益则被指定支付至攻击者控制的比特币地址。攻击据报于 11 月 14 日美国中部时间晚 8 时左右开始。OCEAN 仪表盘显示，其算力一度接近 50 EH/s，随后回落至约 40 EH/s。CoreX Hosting 最先发出警报，称矿机未经授权被切换至其他矿池。一名受影响的运营商称，其整个矿场遭到劫持，并指出 Luxor 的 Commander 矿机管理软件是此次安全事件的源头；其他运营商则报告称，数日前也发生过类似的矿池未经授权变更。CoreX 随后表示，攻击似乎已经结束，被劫持的算力从 13 EH/s 降至约 100 PH/s。攻击者未能在劫持期间挖出比特币区块，因此未获得区块奖励；受影响矿工则永久失去了攻击期间获得比特币的机会。此次安全事件的完整影响范围，以及 Luxor Commander 是否遭到入侵，尚未得到独立确认。

64,000 Bitcoin Mining Machines Hijacked, Redirecting 13 EH/s to OCEAN Pool

Bitcoin News reported that approximately 64,000 Bitcoin mining machines, representing about 13 EH/s of hashrate, were hijacked around 20:00 U.S. Central Time on November 14. The attackers redirected the hashrate to OCEAN and replaced the mining payout address with one they controlled, briefly pushing the pool's hashrate close to 50 EH/s.

CoreX Hosting said the incident appeared to have ended on November 15, with the affected hashrate falling to around 100 PH/s. The attackers failed to mine any blocks and received no block rewards, although affected miners lost mining revenue during the incident. A potential compromise of Luxor Commander software has not been independently confirmed. — link

64,000 Bitcoin Mining Machines Hijacked, Redirecting 13 EH/s to OCEAN Pool

Bitcoin News reported that approximately 64,000 Bitcoin mining machines, representing about 13 EH/s of hashrate, were hijacked around 20:00 U.S. Central Time on November 14. The attackers redirected the hashrate to OCEAN and replaced the mining payout address with one they controlled, briefly pushing the pool's hashrate close to 50 EH/s.

CoreX Hosting said the incident appeared to have ended on November 15, with the affected hashrate falling to around 100 PH/s. The attackers failed to mine any blocks and received no block rewards, although affected miners lost mining revenue during the incident. A potential compromise of Luxor Commander software has not been independently confirmed.

Luxor said internal monitoring detected unauthorized hashrate redirection via its Commander tool last night, affecting over 10 customer accounts and briefly switching some miners to other pools. Engineers patched the issue within two hours and began restoring the original pool settings. No data was leaked, and affected customers will receive full compensation based on normal mining earnings. Commander is back to normal; Luxor Pool, LuxOS and other services were unaffected. A full incident postmortem will follow. — link

items.author: Cointelegraph by Paul Brody
items.content:
Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead
With scalability, privacy tools and onchain liquidity improving, businesses may finally have the infrastructure to make enterprise blockchain work.
Opinion by Paul Brody, founder and chief executive, Nightfall Networks
Do you remember Pets.com? It raised $110 million from Amazon and others to build a business where people ordered pet toys and dog food online.
The company crashed and burned, and everyone learned an important lesson: you can’t profitably ship a 50-pound bag of dog food to a customer’s door.
As online retail entrepreneur Ed Baum asked in a 2001 postmortem: “Did Pets.com’s business plan assume the invention of transporters to magically move bags of pet food without shipping costs?”
Please, whatever you do, don’t share this with the people at Chewy; they might not realize their business model doesn’t work. Chewy reported $12.6 billion in sales and $223 million in net income in its latest fiscal year.
The real lesson of Pets.com wasn’t that shipping dog food was a bad idea. It’s that the idea arrived before the logistics, customer habits and unit economics required to make it work.
As it was with chew toys and dog food, so it may be with enterprise blockchains.
Collectively, the crypto industry probably incinerated just as much money trying that between 2017 and 2023 as Pets.com. Maybe more. But the dozens of companies that went after enterprise blockchain were not delusional; they were just too early.
Why businesses need enterprise blockchains
It’s not hard to understand the appeal of enterprise blockchain solutions, at least superficially. Nearly all enterprise systems today tend to fail at the boundaries between companies. There are two failure modes: mode 1, the OG failure mode, where collaboration information is constantly out of sync.
In this world, enterprise IT systems are islands, communicating asynchronously with each other by digital text messages and emailed spreadsheets. It’s cheap and easy to set up, if you don’t mind always having slightly wrong information.
Related: Privacy is missing ingredient for business blockchain adoption: EY exec
Failure mode two is the costly, real-time proprietary integration. Powerful industry leaders politely request their key suppliers and partners to join their closed but always-on networks.
Chewy reported $223 million in net income in its latest fiscal year. Source: Chewy.
These are very costly, but they work well and leave everyone with a kind of business version of Stockholm syndrome, where you come to appreciate the thoroughness and efficiency of the digital choke-hold you are in.
Blockchains offered a better path forward: shared information and business logic across an open ecosystem. All the benefits of a proprietary system in terms of real-time visibility and efficiency, without the lock-in.
Sometime around 2017, this started to look like a very obvious good idea. Investment poured in, consortia launched, press releases were drafted and released, and then pretty much everything crashed and burned. TradeLens, We.Trade, Contour, B3i, ASX Chess, Everledger. All came and went in just a few years.
Though there is a lot of nuance to the details of each of these stories, they all largely have one thing in common: they had to do unnatural things to make up for the lack of privacy available natively in blockchains.
Companies need privacy, not transparency
No company wants their competition to see what they’re doing in detail. Mostly, this meant building a private/permissioned chain and then doing lots of non-blockchain-like things to it and in it to try to keep information private. The results were uniformly slow and expensive and failed to gain traction.
It’s hard to understate the bloodbath of companies and startups that tried and failed to make enterprise blockchain work. A quick web and history search turned up 18 different ones, some of them well-known.
Many had big-name backers, from major banks like Deutsche Bank and HSBC to technology companies like IBM. Pedigreed parents and big brands made no difference — privacy didn’t work and the results were dismal.
What few survivors of this are left have “de-chained” themselves — giving up the blockchain theater and reverting to a classic software-as-a-service (SaaS) model. Many companies that tried and tested these permissioned enterprise systems as users came away from their experience with a clear learning: we tried blockchain, it didn’t work.
That’s unfortunate because everything is different now.
Blockchains today have scalability, privacy and liquidity
Blockchains have scale. Ethereum in 2020 handled 1 million transactions a day and costs per transaction periodically spiked to $30-50 when demand was high. Today, most transactions get done under a penny and capacity is ramping toward billions of transactions a day. Nobody talks about the “trilemma” anymore. Ethereum is decentralized and it is scaled.
Related: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam upgrade launches on Sepolia testnet
Privacy is different now, too. While privacy is still not the default setting, a huge range of privacy tools and systems are now available, from privacy pools to zero-knowledge roll-ups and full privacy chains.
On top of that, Ethereum is building a range of tools that will add basic elements of privacy at multiple levels in the network. The result: it’s now possible to run business operations at scale with a high degree of privacy.
Finally, there’s the money. It’s all moving onchain. Regulators around the globe have blessed stablecoins and the result is a tsunami of liquidity, with transaction volume reaching almost $1.8 trillion in June.
If we combine the operational benefits of blockchains with the financial ones, we get something that enterprises have never really had before: a single ecosystem where you can not only buy, sell, and move assets, but get paid for them as well.
There was just under $1.8 trillion in adjusted stablecoin transaction volume in June. Source: Visa
The return on investment from every single component of this equation is big. Combined, they can yield colossal advantages. McKinsey partners even found that digital supply chain tools could make inventory reductions of 35-75% possible through better planning.
More conservatively, from my experience in the field, just switching away from the existing cascades of spreadsheets and electronic data interchange (EDI) messages can allow firms to run most supply chains with about 20% less inventory at the same service level. That’s worth billions in working capital in most industries.
It gets better from there. Smart contracts reduce the time required to handle many business contract rules from days to minutes and cut the costs of administration in half.
Microsoft began moving its Xbox video game network onto smart contracts for handling royalties and cut the time to access monthly royalty statements from 45 days to four minutes. All that while handling more than 2 million transactions a day.
And once you have inventories, contracts, purchase orders and invoices onchain, you can go after working capital directly as well.
When you can prove your purchase order originates from a top-quality buyer, you can access credit for less. And when you have full visibility into inventory and delivery status, you can factor receivables immediately and efficiently.
The possibilities and the returns are big. The use cases are obvious. It’s time to try again.
Magazine: What Democrats’ US midterm sweep means for the CLARITY Act
About the author: Paul Brody is the Founder and CEO of Nightfall Networks, a blockchain technology company focused on building robust privacy systems for enterprise users. He is the former Global Blockchain Leader at EY and the former Chairman of the Enterprise Ethereum Alliance.
items.title: Enterprise blockchain is going to come back from the dead

约6.4万台比特币矿机算力遭劫持，攻击者未能成功挖出区块获取收益

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，约 6.4 万台比特币矿机遭到劫持，涉及算力约 13 EH/s，攻击者将这些矿机的算力转移至 OCEAN 矿池，并将收益地址设置为其控制的比特币地址。此次攻击据称于 11 月 14 日美国中部时间 20:00（北京时间 11 月 15 日上午 10:00）左右开始。

OCEAN 矿池仪表盘显示，其算力短时间内大幅飙升，一度接近 50 EH/s，随后回落至约 40 EH/s。矿机托管服务商 CoreX Hosting 最先发出警报，称部分矿机未经授权便被切换至其他矿池。

一名受影响的矿场运营商表示，其整个矿场均遭到劫持，并指出 Luxor 的 Commander 矿机管理软件可能是此次安全事件的源头。其他运营商也报告称，几天前就出现过类似的矿池未经授权切换事件，这可能意味着此次事件涉及更大范围的攻击。

CoreX 随后表示，攻击似乎已经结束，被劫持的算力已从 13 EH/s 降至约 100 PH/s。攻击者在劫持期间未能成功挖出比特币区块，因此没有获得任何区块奖励。不过，受影响的矿工永久损失了攻击期间本可获得的比特币挖矿收益，这部分算力时间无法追回。目前，此次事件的完整影响范围，以及 Luxor Commander 是否遭到入侵，尚未得到独立核实。
