items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs lost about $829 million this week, extending a seven-day outflow streak and bringing November outflows to roughly $2.1 billion.
- Ethereum ETFs snapped a six-day losing streak Friday but lost about $336 million on the week, and Solana ETFs shed about $28 million.
- Bitcoin traded near $64,500 over the weekend, down about 15% on the week and more than 22% over 30 days, as Fed rate fears weighed on the market.
Bitcoin ETF investors are still heading for the exits, and the price slide is speeding up.
U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, according to Decrypt’s ETF tracker, extending their outflow streak to seven straight trading days.
The funds lost about $829 million this week after shedding nearly $1.3 billion the week before, bringing November’s outflows to roughly $2.1 billion.
The selling so far this month has been relentless. The funds bled $1.4 billion over five sessions earlier in the streak as investors cut risk. Cumulative net inflows since launch have slipped to $55.3 billion, and total net assets fell to $94.9 billion, below the $100 billion mark they held through much of October.
Other crypto funds haven’t escaped the rout. Ethereum ETFs took in a modest $2.3 million on Friday, snapping a six-day outflow streak, but still lost about $336 million on the week and roughly $702 million so far in November. Solana ETFs shed about $28 million this week, though they retain $1.6 billion in cumulative net inflows.
Spot crypto ETFs hold the underlying asset, such as Bitcoin or Ethereum, and trade on stock exchanges like ordinary shares, giving investors exposure through a regular brokerage account. Bitcoin funds have drawn $55.3 billion in net inflows since debuting in January 2024. Because issuers report flows daily and much of the money comes from institutions and financial advisers, the figures have become a closely watched gauge of investor sentiment.
The outflows have tracked a sharp sell-off. Bitcoin traded near $64,500 over the weekend, down 6% over 24 hours and about 15% on the week, according to CoinGecko, and it has lost more than 22% over the past month.
Ethereum fell 8.4% to about $1,790, and Solana dropped 12% to roughly $70. Total crypto market value slid 4.5% to about $2.3 trillion.
Bitcoin hit a 12-week low this week as fears of further Federal Reserve rate hikes erased its summer rally, and concentrated liquidations pushed the price below $69,000 earlier in the week.
Not every institution is retreating. JPMorgan’s holdings of Bitcoin and crypto-linked securities are approaching $1 billion, according to its most recent SEC filing. However, those purchases predate the more recent market downturn.

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，链上分析师 Psyche 发文表示，做市商 Wintermute 近 30 天在 Hyperliquid 的交易流优先权（Gossip Priority）拍卖中花费约 82.4 万美元，按此计算年化支出约 1000 万美元。该机制于 2026 年 4 月上线，每 3 分钟拍卖一次，共设 3 个优先席位，最高席位可比未获得优先权的参与者提前约 60 毫秒接收尚未执行的交易数据。Wintermute 主要竞购 0 号席位，10 月赢得约 74.7% 的相关拍卖轮次。链上数据显示，Wintermute、Selini Capital 和另一家未具名做市商合计贡献了约 99% 的拍卖支出。

然而，Wintermute 自 2024 年以来累计约 2.297 亿美元的账户盈利，不能直接归因于交易优先权。该拍卖机制直到 2026 年 4 月才上线，而 Wintermute 在此之前已累计盈利约 2.04 亿美元；上线后约 7 个月，账户盈利约 2560 万美元，同期席位拍卖支出约 358 万美元。相关账户还持有大量永续合约对冲仓位，因此累计盈亏包含多年做市、方向性交易及库存对冲等多方面收益，交易优先权带来的只是做市业务的潜在边际改善。

值得注意的是，Wintermute 自 11 月 11 日起明显减少竞拍，日均支出从此前约 3 万美元降至约 1 万美元，并将出价集中在美股开盘后的几个小时。Gossip Priority 的核心价值在于让做市商更早看到待执行订单，从而抢先撤单或调整报价，类似传统金融市场中的 Last Look（最后看价）机制。这意味着普通交易者的大额市价单可能面临做市商之间的速度竞争，小型做市商也可能因缺乏优先权而处于劣势。不过，相关钱包归属依赖第三方标签，并非 Wintermute 官方披露。

观点：警惕以太坊基金会地址归属误判，错误钱包标记或加剧市场恐慌

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，链上分析师 Specter 发文表示，近期市场频繁出现「以太坊基金会正在抛售 ETH」的说法，但部分相关钱包的归属标记缺乏充分证据。Specter 以一个被标记为基金会关联地址的钱包为例指出，尽管其早期资金流向可以追溯至基金会相关地址，但中间经历了多个独立实体转账。该钱包长期参与 BAT IC0、Compound、Maker 等 DeFi 活动，累计交易超过 3400 笔，更符合长期参与 IC0 和 DeFi 的独立投资者特征，不能仅凭早期资金关联就将其认定为以太坊基金会钱包。

早期 ETH 分配可能是支付给工程师或团队成员的报酬，也可能涉及投资者的私人交易或场外购买。以太坊基金会曾于 2016 年 1 月披露，向个人和企业进行了价值约 65 万美元的 ETH 私募出售，因此相关资金也可能来自此类交易。历史交易关联并不能证明两个地址由同一主体持有或控制，将所有曾与基金会地址发生过资金往来的钱包直接标记为团队钱包，缺乏充分依据，甚至可能引发不必要的市场恐慌。可靠的钱包归属判断应结合链上追踪与独立的链下证据。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377430

items.content:
Here’s what happened in crypto today
Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.
Today in crypto, RWA protocol stUSDT is winding down operations, ending yield payments and giving tokenholders until May 2027 to redeem their assets. MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem, while OpenAI launched AI payments in ChatGPT.
RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
Real-world asset (RWA) protocol stUSDT has begun winding down operations, nearly three years after reaching a $2.3 billion total value locked (TVL), ending rewards and opening a six-month redemption window for tokenholders.
The team said that interest accrual on stUSDT ended on Saturday, with holders of stUSDT and its wrapped version, wstUSDT, able to redeem through its official portal until May 14, 2027. The team said requests submitted after the deadline will be handled through customer support in monthly batches through August 2027.
The team did not provide a reason for the shutdown but said all underlying assets remain fully backed. Holders with tokens on exchanges or DeFi platforms must transfer them to personal wallets before redeeming.
Cointelegraph reached out to stUSDT for more information but did not receive a response before publication.
Meanwhile, JustLend DAO said it would phase out supply and borrowing functions for its wstUSDT market as part of the transition.
Launched in July 2023 on Tron, stUSDT allowed users to deposit USDT and earn yields from investments in real-world assets, including short-term government bonds. The protocol later expanded to Ethereum.
According to DefiLlama data, stUSDT’s TVL peaked at about $2.3 billion in November 2023 before declining substantially in subsequent years. It stood at about $8.6 million on Sunday, down from roughly $60 million a year earlier.
Despite its name, stUSDT is not affiliated with stablecoin issuer Tether. In September 2023, Tether denied any affiliation with stUSDT, saying the protocol was an independent project.
MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
MEGA, the organization behind Ethereum layer-2 network MegaETH, has reduced its workforce by 20% following months of restructuring as it expands into artificial intelligence products.
On Friday, MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the organization had reorganized its teams, resulting in the departures of staff who worked on its blockchain, wallet, ecosystem support and communications. Kong did not disclose the number of employees affected or when the layoffs occurred. She said MEGA’s founders, early employees and core engineering team remain committed to the organization.
“We’ve brought together new capabilities and reorganized our teams, a process that has resulted in a 20% reduction in our staff,” Kong said. “These are people who helped build MEGA from its earliest days.”
The workforce reduction comes as MEGA shifts its focus toward developing products on the MegaETH network, including artificial intelligence services. The organization has committed $30 million to the initiative, although Kong did not directly link the layoffs to its new strategy.
In a whitepaper, MegaETH co-founders Yilong Li and Lei Yang outlined a proposed inference market aimed at giving users access to competing AI service providers. Their approach seeks to address concerns about whether providers use the advertised models and how they handle customer data.
Kong said MEGA plans to launch a public inference market in December.
OpenAI launches AI payments in ChatGPT with Visa, Mastercard and Amex
OpenAI on Friday introduced a new feature allowing AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users directly within ChatGPT through existing payment networks, in collaboration with American Express, Mastercard and Visa.
The wallet lets users authorize transactions using biometric verification, such as facial recognition or fingerprints. Payment networks generate tokenized card credentials for each approved purchase, keeping users’ actual card details from merchants and AI agents, the company said.
The service is being rolled out to ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US with eligible cards issued in the country. OpenAI said it plans to eventually support purchases within preset spending limits and other restrictions without requiring approval for each transaction.
The launch comes as AI companies seek to move beyond product recommendations into executing transactions, potentially changing how consumers interact with online merchants. OpenAI said it is working with payment processors and fraud prevention firms to support AI purchases through existing checkout systems.

知名HYPE持有者：建议自行在链上保管资产，以减少CEX操纵市场空间

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，知名 HYPE 持有者 NMTD.HL 发文表示，中心化交易平台（CEX）可能利用用户存入的平台资产进行交易，在导致用户仓位遭到清算后，再将相关代币补回原有账户或储备，并从中赚取差价。他还声称，存入 CEX 的大多数代币可能长期面临价格压力，因为用户实际上将资产价格的控制权交给了平台及其管理层。NMTD.HL 认为，这种行为已经持续多年，正在不断消耗加密行业的流动性，并质疑部分中心化交易平台仍可能存在偿付能力问题。

NMTD.HL 呼吁用户自行保管链上资产，将 BTC、ETH 及其他加密资产转移至链上。用户越多地转向链上交易，并通过 Hyperliquid 等去中心化平台进行交易，中心化交易平台利用用户资产操纵价格、针对用户止损和清算仓位的机会就越少。

NMTD.HL 进一步表示，中心化平台属于缺乏透明度的封闭系统，其盈利模式可能涉及利用用户存款与用户进行反向交易，并通过触发止损和清算获利。加密行业要实现长期发展，必须减少对中心化交易平台的依赖，而 Hyperliquid 才是推动行业实现这一转变的关键平台。

Serenity：预计AI瓶颈领域2027年将出现大量超额收益机会

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，Serenity 发文表示，黄仁勋在英伟达的管理经验揭示了一个重要的供应链策略：如果企业能够以较低成本提前锁定关键材料供应，却能因此避免竞争对手因供应短缺遭受数百亿美元的经济损失，那么提前锁定产能就具有极高的战略价值。以 SOI 为例，其 2028 财年光子学业务收入预计约为 4 亿美元。这种供应链博弈将推动关键瓶颈环节的采购需求在 2027 年进一步向上游传导，而且这一趋势不会因黄仁勋是否继续主导而改变。

在具体投资方向上，摩根士丹利重点关注的覆铜板（CCL）、ABF 载板、印制电路板（PCB）及光模块组件等领域值得关注，但其更看好成本占比较低、供应约束较强的细分零部件，以及能够以较低成本提前锁定产能的关键环节。目前，去杠杆压力和市场悲观情绪正在无差别地影响相关产业链标的，导致个股基本面暂时难以得到充分体现。

Serenity 进一步表示，回顾 2026 年的投资表现，自己在筛选 2027 年投资标的时需要更加谨慎。不过，随着近封装光学（NPO）和共封装光学（CPO）等新型架构逐步在整个产业生态中落地，供应链中的关键瓶颈环节仍有望涌现大量超额投资机会。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377428

Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.
Bitcoin fell to a four-month low near $62,000 on Sunday, extending a selloff across major digital assets before recovering some of its losses.
On Sunday, Bitcoin (BTC) dropped to a 24-hour low of $62,080.91, according to CoinGecko, its weakest level since July. The asset later rebounded above $65,000 but remained down nearly 15% in the last seven days.
The downturn extended beyond Bitcoin. CoinGecko data showed Ether (ETH) down 19.5% over the past week, while Solana (SOL) lost 20.7%. The total value of the cryptocurrency market fell about 4% over 24 hours to $2.26 trillion, according to CoinGecko.
Market sentiment also deteriorated. The Crypto Fear & Greed Index fell to 10 on Sunday from 13 on Saturday and 20 on Friday, remaining in “extreme fear,” according to Alternative.me.
The move followed Friday’s slide below $70,000, as analysts reported weakening investor sentiment and concerns over institutional outflows and tighter liquidity.
The latest decline came after US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds posted $2.35 billion in net outflows over two consecutive weeks. The funds lost $1.07 billion during the week ended Nov. 13, following $1.28 billion the previous week. BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust extended its outflow streak to 11 trading sessions on Friday.
Related: Bitcoin returns to 200-week trend line as analyst sees risk of $57.7K next

OneKey创始人：洗盘期间应远离杠杆与山寨币，坚守比特币现货持仓

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，OneKey 创始人 Yishi 在社交媒体发文表示，金融市场交易的从来不是昨日的情绪，而是对未来共识和流动性的预期。近期 BTC 价格走势令不少投资者感到失望，整个加密市场也普遍陷入疲惫情绪，部分投资者更遭受了严重的财务损失和投资组合回撤。但现在恰恰不是屈服于绝望的时候。市场洗盘和流动性枯竭是周期演变的一部分，2015 年、2018 年、2022 年以及 2026 年均经历过类似阶段，未来即使 BTC 从 100 万美元跌至 50 万美元，市场也可能重演这一过程。真正具备长期价值的核心资产，往往是在市场关注度最低、情绪最悲观时确立自身地位。

投资者应避免使用杠杆和高风险债务押注周期底部，远离山寨币和一夜暴富的幻想，坚持核心现货持仓，同时保留充足现金流以保障正常生活。BTC 往往会通过极度绝望完成市场洗盘，只有当市场情绪彻底冻结，下一轮行情才可能开启。在残酷的市场环境中，生存始终是第一要务，时间最终会筛选出真正能够熬过完整周期的投资者。

Germany approves new customs powers to seize suspected illicit assets, including cryptoGermany Approves New Customs Powers to Seize Suspected Illicit Assets, Including Crypto

Germany’s Bundestag has approved legislation allowing customs authorities to temporarily secure significant assets, including crypto, when there are substantiated doubts about their lawful origin even before a criminal case is opened. The procedure generally targets assets worth more than €100,000, while permanent confiscation would still require a fiscal court ruling.

The law is scheduled to take effect on January 1, 2027, subject to Bundesrat approval and formal promulgation. — link

SK海力士计划进一步扩大HBM4产能，目标每月增产2万片HBM

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，据韩国《电子新闻》报道，SK 海力士计划进一步扩大高带宽内存（HBM4）产能。据多位半导体设备企业相关人士 11 月 15 日透露，SK 海力士正在与合作伙伴商讨采购 HBM4 生产设备的订单。据悉，公司主要与负责 HBM 键合、切割和检测等后道工序的设备供应商协调采购时间和数量。

一位知情的 SK 海力士供应商人士表示：「SK 海力士正在推进 HBM4 生产设备的追加投资，目标是在明年上半年完成设备进场和安装调试，目前正在加快相关安排。」据悉，公司要求部分设备最迟于明年第一季度交付，显示出此次产能扩张计划推进较为迅速。

新增产能预计将主要落地于 SK 海力士位于韩国清州的 P&T6 工厂。该工厂此前被称为 M8，是 SK 海力士于 2025 年选定的 HBM 生产基地，公司从今年年初开始在此建设 HBM 生产线。随着此次追加扩产决定，公司计划进一步提高 HBM4 产能，进度可能早于原定计划。

另一位业内人士表示：「公司计划最大限度利用 P&T6 工厂的闲置空间，以提升 HBM4 产能。如果整座工厂全面投产，按晶圆计算，每月可额外增加超过 2 万片 HBM 产能。」

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377423

Gate回应用户资产被印度警方司法冻结一事：案件仍在审查，尚未移交任何资产

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，据官方公告，针对一名用户资产被印度警方要求司法冻结一事，Gate 回应表示，平台作为独立第三方，不会仅凭单方面材料对涉案资金作出判断或承诺移交资产。每一项请求都会内部逐案审核，而目前没有任何资产被移交。整个案件从 2025 年至今，Gate 一直在投入法律资源持续跟进，帮用户建立沟通渠道和争取时间，并非收到印度警方要求后就直接配合执行。

 2025 年 9 月，Gate 收到印度警方的资产冻结请求，其反洗钱团队和法务团队随后多次要求补充证据及案件材料。Gate 称，警方提供的链上记录涉及多个钱包及资金往来。2026 年 4 月，警方提出资产移交相关请求，Gate 未直接承诺执行，继续要求补充材料。根据同年 9 月的沟通，案件当时仍处于司法审查中。Gate 会持续保持这部分资金，在用户抗辩过程中，不会轻易划走，持续帮用户解决问题。

Gate 表示，在收到警方关于提交起诉材料的通知当天，平台即询问能否向用户披露进展，并在获得同意后告知相关用户，以便其寻求法律救济。根据当地律所意见，Gate 作为第三方无法代替用户抗辩或提出异议，但会继续协助用户与有关方面沟通，并提供法律支持。Gate 称，在用户抗辩期间，平台将继续保留相关资金，并在有新进展时同步。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach
The South Korean crypto exchange said potentially exposed information includes passwords, bank account numbers, national identification numbers and crypto wallet addresses.
South Korean crypto exchange Coinone warned customers of potential phishing scams and identity theft after an attacker breached its outsourced customer support provider, exposing information shared during customer service interactions.
On Sunday, Coinone said an attacker accessed servers operated by MetaM on Thursday and viewed or extracted customer support records. Coinone said it learned about the breach in the same day.
According to Coinone, the information potentially exposed names, phone numbers, email addresses, dates of birth, bank account numbers, passwords, national identification numbers, home and wallet addresses and transaction IDs.
Coinone said the affected data varies by customer, and people who never contacted its support center were unaffected. It did not disclose how many customers were affected.
The exchange urged customers who shared passwords during support interactions to change them and warned that fraudsters could impersonate Coinone using details from previous conversations.
Coinone said its account, trading and wallet infrastructure operates separately from MetaM’s servers, with no evidence of direct compromise. The exchange said it has reported the incident to South Korean authorities.
The disclosure comes as South Korea moves to strengthen financial-sector cybersecurity. In October, the Financial Services Commission identified security deficiencies at 130 of 555 financial firms reviewed.
On Thursday, the regulator said it would allow crypto exchanges to suspend withdrawals when hacking is suspected, alongside calls for round-the-clock monitoring.
Related: GOPAX halts crypto trading, withdrawals to move all assets to cold storage
items.title: Coinone warns of phishing, identity theft after customer data breach

items.content:
RWA protocol stUSDT winds down three years after $2.3B TVL peak
The stUSDT team did not disclose a reason for winding down the RWA protocol but assured holders that all underlying assets remain fully backed.
Real-world asset (RWA) protocol stUSDT has begun winding down operations, nearly three years after reaching a $2.3 billion total value locked (TVL), ending rewards and opening a six-month redemption window for tokenholders.
The team said that interest accrual on stUSDT ended on Saturday, with holders of stUSDT and its wrapped version, wstUSDT, able to redeem through its official portal until May 14, 2027. The team said requests submitted after the deadline will be handled through customer support in monthly batches through August 2027.
The team did not provide a reason for the shutdown but said all underlying assets remain fully backed. Holders with tokens on exchanges or DeFi platforms must transfer them to personal wallets before redeeming.
Cointelegraph reached out to stUSDT for more information but did not receive a response before publication.
Meanwhile, JustLend DAO said it would phase out supply and borrowing functions for its wstUSDT market as part of the transition.
Launched in July 2023 on Tron, stUSDT allowed users to deposit USDT and earn yields from investments in real-world assets, including short-term government bonds. The protocol later expanded to Ethereum.
According to DefiLlama data, stUSDT’s TVL peaked at about $2.3 billion in November 2023 before declining substantially in subsequent years. It stood at about $8.6 million on Sunday, down from roughly $60 million a year earlier.
Despite its name, stUSDT is not affiliated with stablecoin issuer Tether. In September 2023, Tether denied any affiliation with stUSDT, saying the protocol was an independent project.
Related: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds

items.content:
Anthropic前研究员再发警告：算法进步正在加速，训练更强AI可能无需靠堆算力

动察 Beating AI 快讯，今年 9 月，曾在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 从事预训练研究的 Jacob Coxon 辞职，怒斥两家公司正冲向能够自我改进的超级智能，简直是在「拿我们的生命赌博」。这番言论引来美国议员呼吁加强监管，马斯克甚至怀疑他是在配合监管宣传造势。

现在，Coxon 又贴出 Anthropic IPO 路演中的一张图，称这是促使他辞职的重要原因之一。「这张图太疯狂了，没想到他们竟然公开了。」

Anthropic 原本用这张图展示自己的技术优势：随着算法不断改进，训练出同等代码能力的模型，所需算力越来越少。

但 Coxon 注意到，图中的纵轴已经采用对数刻度，曲线却依然越来越陡。这意味着，如果数据准确，训练效率的提升速度本身也在加快。他据此认为，Anthropic 的算法进步已经呈现「超指数增长」。

Mythos 可能只是这条陡峭曲线上的普通一站。Anthropic 已经可以用远少于最初的算力，训练出与 Mythos 同等水平的模型。如果投入相同的算力，就有可能训练出更强的 AI。

而改进训练算法也不一定需要天才研究员不断提出突破性想法，这类工作已经接近能够自动化的阶段。Anthropic 联合创始人 Tom Brown 在路演中也谈到，未来 Claude 有望自行发现提高训练效率的方法。新方法可以用来训练更强的模型，而更强的模型又能继续寻找新的优化方法。

不过，这张图没有公开具体的算力倍数，只有三个数据点，图下注明位置仅供示意。

Coxon 主张应该在 2027 年暂停前沿 AI 研发，让竞争对手追上。这样会让人类水平的 AI 能力逐渐成为人人可用的普通商品，打破 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 依靠领先模型建立的优势。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377406

知情人士：黄仁勋离任后仍参与英伟达新任CEO遴选，已致电至少一名潜在人选

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，据《华盛顿邮报》报道，黄仁勋辞任 CEO 后，英伟达面临的难题不只是寻找一位新负责人，还要接手一套长期围绕创始人运转的管理体系。黄仁勋执掌英伟达逾 30 年，公司采用扁平化管理，约 60 人直接向他汇报，重大决策集中在他手中。英伟达目前由首席财务官 Colette Kress 出任临时 CEO。据知情人士透露，黄仁勋仍参与继任者遴选，并已致电至少一名潜在人选。

黄仁勋还亲自维系英伟达与关键供应商的关系。他与台积电创始人张忠谋长期保持密切往来，这一关系曾帮助英伟达优先获得紧缺的制造产能。哈佛商学院教授 Andy Wu 认为，在亚马逊和谷歌也争夺台积电有限产能的情况下，英伟达能否维持原有的产能份额存在不确定性。英伟达发言人则表示，公司与台积电及其他供应链伙伴的合作关系依然稳固。

《The Nvidia Way》作者 Tae Kim 指出，黄仁勋同时主导产品方向、商业战略、市场推广和人才招募，新 CEO 很难独自接手全部职责。他认为，董事会应优先留住熟悉公司技术与运作方式的核心高管，包括主导 CUDA 开发的 Ian Buck、负责 GPU 工程的 Jonah Alben，以及临时 CEO Colette Kress。Andy Wu 则指出，英伟达的继任者既要理解芯片技术，又要有管理能力，还需推动公司在自动驾驶、机器人等领域的布局。

哈佛商学院教授、英特尔前董事 David Yoffie 表示，与英特尔每年评估继任人选的做法不同，英伟达并未建立类似的系统化接班流程。英伟达自风波发生以来市值缩水约 1 万亿美元。Bernstein 已将其目标价从 400 美元下调至 200 美元，理由之一是新任 CEO 能否接替黄仁勋此前承担的多重职责仍不明朗。

Meta、Sierra的AI「通行证」铺向数百万商家，已能对接银行转账和航班升舱

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Meta 与 Sierra 联合发起的个人智能体协议 Poppy 发布 1.0 版本，开始从草案走向大规模应用。Shopify 已为平台数百万商家自动发布接入文件，无需店主额外操作。Meta 的个人 AI 智能体 Muse 也已全面启用这套协议，每次访问网站都会优先查找 Poppy。

Poppy 相当于给 AI Agent 配了一张商家「通行证」。商家只需公布一份接入说明，AI 就能知道有哪些服务可以调用、如何登录，以及需要用户授予哪些权限。接入后，AI 可以直接调用商家的 API，或者与商家的客服智能体沟通，减少反复打开网页、点击按钮的麻烦。Shopify 还把 Poppy 与购物协议 UCP 打通，前者负责身份识别和授权，后者负责商品搜索、加购物车和结账。

金融科技公司 Mercury 允许 AI 查询银行余额、整理交易记录，甚至发起转账，但资金划转仍需经过账户审批。土耳其航空则允许 AI 查询航班、调取预订信息、寻找商务舱升舱机会，并在用户确认后完成升舱付款。

此次又有 60 家企业加入协议设计，包括 Salesforce、Zoom、达美航空等，合作伙伴总数超过 100 家。

【分析：加密总市值自 10 月初以来蒸发约 8000 亿美元，市场流动性承压】

Foresight News 消息，BIT 独立分析师分析称，自 10 月初以来，加密货币总市值已从 2.9 万亿美元降至 2.1 万亿美元，蒸发约 8000 亿美元。BTC 今早一度下跌约 9%，最低触及 6.2 万美元附近，随后有所反弹。分析指出，与上周末仅约 290 亿美元的成交量相比，本周下跌期间成交量放大至约 1070 亿美元，爆仓加速，但承接买盘有限，市场正在寻找流动性。过去 30 天稳定币净流出扩大至约 140 亿美元，可用于承接抛压的资金减少。周末银行休市，新增法币资金难以快速入场；在宏观环境本就疲弱的背景下，部分投资者对近期网络安全风险的担忧也在上升。BIT 在 10 月 16 日的《BIT on Target》报告中曾建议减持多头仓位，彼时 BTC 价格仍在 8.2 万美元。

Coinone客服外包商遭入侵，部分用户个人信息外泄

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，韩国加密交易平台 Coinone 发布公告，11 月 12 日凌晨，其客服外包商 MetaM 的服务器遭外部入侵，部分客户在聊天或电话咨询中留下的个人信息外泄。Coinone 当日上午约 9:20 接到外包商报告，并于 11 月 15 日披露此事。没有客服咨询记录的用户不受此次事件影响。Coinone 称，其账户、交易及钱包系统与外包商服务器独立运行，目前未发现这些系统遭直接入侵。

可能泄露的信息包括姓名、电话、邮箱、出生日期、账户号码、密码、韩国居民登记号码、证件签发日期、住址、钱包地址及交易哈希（TXID）。实际泄露项目因用户在咨询中提供的信息而异，Coinone 尚未披露受影响人数，后续将通过单独通知或查询服务告知用户。

Coinone 已阻断非法访问路径，将外包客服切换为邮件咨询，并加强对异常登录和交易的监测。平台已向韩国相关监管机构报告，并提醒曾在客服咨询中提供密码的用户尽快修改 Coinone 及其他使用相同密码的网站密码，警惕冒充客服的钓鱼电话、短信和邮件。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377392
items.title: Coinone客服外包商遭入侵，部分用户个人信息外泄

items.content:
分析师：本轮抛售主要由杠杆出清引发，建议「在恐慌中买入」

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，Wellington-Altus 策略分析师 James E. Thorne 发文表示，比特币的「头肩底」形态仍未被破坏，左肩位于 5.9 万美元附近，头部位于 5.7 万美元附近，右肩正在形成。比特币接下来需要先收复 7.3 万美元，再突破 8.7 万美元，才能确认这一形态。

若形态得到确认，Thorne 将 2027 年中目标看至 11.7 万美元，并预计比特币随后有望突破 12.6 万美元的历史高点，年底目标为 15 万至 17 万美元。他认为，本轮抛售主要由杠杆仓位出清引发，而非基本面恶化，在恐慌中买入。若比特币跌破 5.7 万美元，上述判断将失效。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377391
items.title: 分析师：本轮抛售主要由杠杆出清引发，建议「在恐慌中买入」

加密市场遭「血洗」，主要原因系美联储多次加息预期升温、ETF持续净流出以及科技股抛售等所致

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，据 HTX 行情，比特币下跌一度触及 6.2 万美元，24 小时跌超 8%，以太坊 24 小时跌超 10%。过去 24 小时全网爆仓突破 20 亿美元，超 32 万人被爆仓。本轮抛售并非由单一事件触发：美国现货加密 ETF 已连续多日遭遇净流出，市场从押注 12 月单次加息转向计入后续加息，而价格下跌又触发了大规模多头清算。

利率市场开始计入美联储多次加息。美国 10 月 CPI 环比上涨 0.4%，核心 CPI 环比上涨 0.3%，高于市场预期。英国《金融时报》报道称，截至周五，利率市场已充分计入美联储 12 月加息 25 个基点，并大体计入明年 1 月再次加息；一周前，1 月加息概率仅约 10%。美银全球研究则预计，美联储将在 12 月、明年 1 月和 3 月各加息 25 个基点，累计加息 75 个基点。

比特币和以太坊现货 ETF 持续流出。截至 11 月 13 日，美国现货比特币 ETF 已连续 7 个交易日净流出，累计约 19.1 亿美元；当周净流出 10.7 亿美元，连续第二周超过 10 亿美元。美国现货以太坊 ETF 当周也净流出约 3.99 亿美元，连续第七周录得净流出。比特币 ETF 此轮净流出始于 11 月 5 日，早于美国 CPI 公布和黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO，意味着这两件事发生前，ETF 渠道的买盘就已转弱。

科技股抛售可能波及加密仓位，多头清算则放大了跌势。BitMine 董事长 Tom Lee 认为，英伟达及其他半导体股的抛售可能触发追加保证金要求，尤其波及亚洲散户。Tom Lee 还将 Binance 63 亿美元的加密资产被盗案列为潜在因素：相关账户资金恢复可用后，部分持有人可能转持现金或稳定币。

Anthropic IPO 可能分流资金。Anthropic 拟通过 IPO 和同步私募配售合计募资至多约 904 亿美元，据彭博社报道，认购订单约为可发售股份的 6 倍。Tom Lee 认为，部分投资者可能提前卖出股票筹资；如果 Robinhood 获得较大规模配售，部分散户也可能出售加密资产参与认购。

Strategy 将被剔除出 MSCI 美国指数。MSCI 在 11 月指数审议中确认将 Strategy（MSTR）移出 MSCI 美国指数，调整将于 11 月 30 日美股收盘后生效。Strategy 此前披露，追踪相关 MSCI 指数的基金持有约 1300 万股，占其已发行基本股数的 3.1%；摩根大通此前估算，剔除可能带来约 28 亿美元的被动卖盘。指数调整并不要求 Strategy 出售比特币。对比特币市场而言，更值得关注的是：若被动买盘减少令股价持续承压，Strategy 通过发行股票筹资增持比特币的能力可能减弱。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，Coinkarma 创始人 Benson Sun 发文复盘近期行情称，不少交易者在本轮下跌中回吐了此前的利润，部分账户回撤达数百万甚至上千万美元，也有人亏光离场。他认为，以 9 月当时掌握的信息来看，包括他在内的多名交易者判断市场处于「牛市初期」，并非不合理。

Benson Sun 表示，但随后发生的 Binance 被盗、民主党拿下美国国会两院以及黄仁勋离任，改变了原有判断成立的前提。交易结果不及预期，并不意味着当时的推理有误；但前提发生变化后，也不应固守原有判断或全盘否定此前的分析。他写道：「该坚持的是分析框架，而不是结论。」

Hougan 指出，当年打破行业低迷局面的是 DeFi 带来的创新突破。他预计，这一轮市场也可能需要新的创新才能走出低迷，但真正的突破很难提前预判。

分析：加密市场由缓跌转向清算加速，多重利空下反弹或难以持续

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，据彭博社报道，比特币周末一度跌近 6.2 万美元，创 7 月以来新低。与以往突然暴跌不同，本轮抛售前期大多发生在交投相对清淡的时段，价格持续走低，直到最近几天杠杆清算才明显加速。许多小市值代币已回吐数年涨幅，机构参与扩大和现货 ETF 的普及也未能阻止本轮下跌。

现货买盘走弱，美债收益率和美元走强。从 10 月 30 日至 11 月 13 日，美国现货比特币 ETF 净流出近 30 亿美元。与此同时，持续偏高的通胀推升了美联储进一步收紧政策的预期，10 年期美债收益率升破 5%，提高了持有比特币等不产生利息资产的机会成本。Binance 遭盗事件重新引发市场对交易平台安全性的担忧，美国中期选举结果也增加了政策不确定性。

Anthropic IPO 可能分流资金，但规模尚不明确。FalconX 市场业务联席主管 Joshua Lim 指出，市场对下跌原因的讨论集中在两个方面：过去一个月流出的稳定币余额接近 200 亿美元，以及 Anthropic IPO 对流动性的潜在影响。彭博社指出，IPO 获得大量认购，部分投资者可能出售包括加密资产在内的其他持仓筹资，但目前无法确定有多少资金直接从加密市场转向这笔 IPO。

比特币曾在美国财政部宣布扩大长期国债回购后，从 8 月不足 6.5 万美元反弹至 9 月下旬的 8.7 万美元上方，如今已回吐大部分涨幅，市场重新关注约 5.8 万美元的年内低点。Monarq Asset Management 首席运营官 Ayesha Kiani 认为，短期走势主要取决于机构需求能否企稳，以及宏观环境能否让风险偏好回升。在此之前，反弹可能难以持续，市场波动也将维持高位。

Binance以太坊储备量降至2021年以来最低水平

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Darkfost 发文指出，Binance 持有的以太坊储备量已降至 2021 年以来未见的低位。目前，Binance 持有的 ETH 预计约为 290 万枚，创近五年来新低。

储备量大幅下降表明，随着 ETH 价格持续走低，许多投资者可能正在选择逢低积累 ETH，并将资产从交易平台转出，用于自托管或参与能够产生收益的 DeFi 策略，以等待更有利的市场环境。

这一趋势也反映在 Binance 的以太坊净流量数据中。以 30 日移动平均值（30DMA）计算，过去大部分时间里，Binance ETH 净流量均处于负值区间，表明资金流出持续超过流入。持续的净流出趋势进一步支持了投资者正在积累 ETH 的判断，但仅凭交易平台资产流出，尚不足以确认投资者正在增持。

从长期来看，如果交易平台 ETH 储备量持续下降，市场上可随时用于出售的 ETH 数量可能随之减少。如果未来需求开始回升，这或将形成更有利的供应环境。

items.content:
⚡️Tom Lee：科技股抛售、Anthropic IPO挤压流动性以及Binance被盗63亿美元后部分持有人套现等因素导致加密市场遭受持续抛售

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 15 日，以太坊财库公司 Bitmine 董事长 Tom Lee 发文表示，尽管多家银行宣布采用加密资产和区块链技术，加密市场过去数周仍遭遇持续抛售。他认为，AI 和半导体股抛售可能触发了追加保证金要求，尤其波及亚洲散户；Anthropic IPO 临近，也可能促使部分投资者提前卖出股票筹资。若 Robinhood 用户获得较大规模的配售，部分散户也可能卖出加密资产以参与认购。

Tom Lee 还将近期涉及 63 亿美元的加密资产被盗事件列为潜在因素之一。他认为，相关账户资金恢复可用后，部分持有人可能将资产换成现金或稳定币。此外，Anthropic 路演中关于 AI 可能削弱现有网络安全防御的讨论，以及美国司法部对销往亚洲、包括中国的芯片展开审查，也可能加重市场的避险情绪。

其认为，上述压力终将消退。长期来看，加密网络可作为交易结算层，数字资产也将改变资本市场，有望推动一轮规模超过以往的加密「超级周期」。他仍看好以太坊在金融体系中的作用。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377374
items.title: ⚡️Tom Lee：科技股抛售、Anthropic IPO挤压流动性以及Binance被盗63亿美元后部分持有人套现等因素导致加密市场遭受持续抛售

[PeterStuer]: It's a 3 way prisoners dilemma market where the prisoners have been caught explicitly colluding before. Now they do not need explicit colluding anymore as the pattern and outcome has been established already and the "jail" is as good as closed to new entrants. Clearly the expected "market" is not working in this niche, so something will have to be done about it.

[bloomingeek]: Having read most of the posts for this subject, I got to thinking: wouldn't it be cool and beneficial to the HN community, if we tried to anticipate equipment price spikes? We tend to be electronic parts focused, so why not post trends as we see them. Example: I, like I'm sure others did, saw the M.2 SSD prices starting to rise. Even though I didn't see the data center build up coming, I bought a small supply of SSDs. Unfortunately I didn't realize the future memory situat...

[sysguest]: idk going with DDR3/4/5 upgrades are really makes me doubt the whole argument... those upgrades ARE ACTUAL UPGRADES, and if exiting ddr4 helps on producing more ddr5, why not? (and the cheap chinese makers can produce plenty of those ddr4 chips, so it's NOT that "monopoly destroying the market" scenario)

[ketzu]: I am curious to see what will be uncovered in the trial. (for example I would be skeptical to build up extremly expensive production if i follow the widespread belief that Ai is a huge bubble) However, collusion is not magically out of the question with previous in...

items.author: Decrypt Staff
items.content:
In brief
- Jensen Huang resigned Thursday as Nvidia’s CEO after 33 years, following reports of three extramarital affairs—one involving an executive U.S. intelligence reportedly suspected of China ties.
- Nvidia’s stock plunged over 14% before recovering to close down ~4.6%; tech, AI and crypto founders called the ouster a “massive mistake,” while 1,600-plus employee comments pushed to reinstate him.
- The board has reportedly approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a successor; the turmoil matters for crypto given Nvidia’s grip on AI data-center infrastructure, with earnings due Nov. 17.
In the span of a few days, the most powerful executive in artificial intelligence went from untouchable to unemployed.
Jensen Huang, who built Nvidia from a graphics-card maker into the roughly $4 trillion engine of the AI boom, resigned Thursday after 33 years, felled not by a bad earnings report but by a scandal with the texture of a spy thriller.
Here’s how a defining week for AI, and by extension crypto, unfolded.
The crisis began with reports that Huang had grown close to Alice Huang (no relation), an executive at Singapore-based Megaspeed, one of Nvidia’s largest Southeast Asian customers, whom U.S. intelligence officials reportedly suspected of gathering information for Beijing.
For a company at the center of the U.S.-China chip fight and a looming debate over tighter export controls, the national-security overtones were impossible to ignore. Nvidia’s board opened an independent investigation into whether Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence operation, though it said it had no reason to believe company secrets or national security were compromised.
On Nov. 8, Huang apologized for being “unfaithful” to his wife, acknowledging the relationship.
Jensen Huang’s exit
What might have been a single lapse quickly snowballed. The New York Times reported a second affair, with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, who reported to Huang.
By Thursday, Huang was out as president, CEO and board member. Chief financial officer Colette Kress was named interim CEO, and longtime director Harvey Jones took over as board chair. The abruptness stunned an industry accustomed to treating Huang as synonymous with Nvidia itself.
Then, a day after his resignation, Reuters reported a third relationship, an “intimate” one with a second unnamed Nvidia employee, citing two people familiar with the matter. Reuters did not identify her, and Nvidia declined to comment. Huang has acknowledged only the Alice Huang affair, deflecting when the Times asked about Powell.
Affair trade
Nvidia’s stock cratered more than 14% at the open on Thursday before clawing back to close down about 4.6%. Wall Street quickly sorted winners from losers: rivals like AMD and Broadcom fared better, while companies tightly tied to Nvidia’s business took the brunt.
The reaction underscored how much of the AI trade, and the crypto market that increasingly moves with it, rests on a single company.
The scandal then rippled outward. Singapore barred Alice Huang from returning to the country, Alibaba shares slid on reports it was a Megaspeed customer, and congressional committees had already sought a closed-door briefing from Huang over his Megaspeed ties.
The loudest names in tech, AI and crypto called the ouster a blunder, with one founder branding it “a massive mistake.” Inside Nvidia, an internal suggestion-box post drew more than 1,600 comments, many pleading for Huang’s return. “If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss,” one wrote.
The board has moved on regardless. According to the Financial Times, it approached Arm CEO Rene Haas, a former Nvidia executive who led Arm through its 2023 IPO, as a potential successor, though Nvidia called speculation about any candidate “premature.” Analysts have also floated Nvidia’s Ian Buck and AMD’s Lisa Su.
Why it matters for crypto
Nvidia’s chips power the AI data centers whose explosive buildout has become intertwined with crypto, from AI-agent commerce to the mining firms pivoting to host AI workloads.
Leadership turmoil at the company that supplies the picks and shovels ripples outward, and it lands amid a broader reckoning over AI’s role in everything from cyberattacks to data-center politics.
Nvidia reports earnings Nov. 17, with Kress at the helm and the permanent CEO search still underway, a nervous moment for a market already rattled by a sharp week-ending selloff.
For now, the company that defined the AI era is leaderless at the top, its founder’s legacy clouded by scandal, and the question hanging over Silicon Valley is whether anyone can fill the role Huang made uniquely his own.

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
- Four nonprofits sued five major AI developers, seeking a freeze on building or releasing more powerful AI models.
- The lawsuit cites incidents involving AI agents escaping testing environments, unauthorized hacking, and warnings about catastrophic risks.
- The plaintiffs argue that California's existing laws can be used to stop dangerous AI development without waiting for new legislation.
Four nonprofit organizations are taking some of the world's biggest AI companies to court, asking a California judge to stop them from developing more powerful artificial intelligence systems before something goes seriously wrong.
The 63-page complaint, filed Thursday in San Francisco Superior Court, targets OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, and SpaceX. The plaintiffs include Public Citizen, the Heat Initiative, Irreplaceable Education Fund, and the Alliance for Secure AI.
They want an immediate court order prohibiting the companies from developing or deploying AI systems more capable than their most advanced models as of November 12, 2026.
“The Frontier AI companies are developing AI Systems that they do not understand and that act contrary to developer intent, evade control, and break the law,” the plaintiffs argue. To prevent this, they request “an immediate injunction forbidding Defendants from developing or deploying AI systems more capable than their most capable systems as of the date of this Complaint”
That wouldn't necessarily mean shutting down ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or other existing products. Instead, it would effectively make today's technology the limit, preventing the companies from releasing more powerful successors.
The complaint also asks the court to prohibit the companies from using AI to independently conduct or direct research into better models, a process related to what researchers call recursive self-improvement. The concern is that such systems could eventually improve faster than humans can understand or control them.
Can AI development be considered a public nuisance?
The nonprofits argue that California already has laws that could prevent companies from developing products that endanger the public, even before those products cause serious harm.
Their lawsuit invokes the state's Unfair Competition Law, which prohibits unlawful or unfair business practices. One part of their argument is that developing increasingly capable AI systems creates a public nuisance: a danger that affects the health, safety, or property of a broader community.
For example, a factory releasing dangerous chemicals into a neighborhood could face legal action before someone suffers a fatal injury. The plaintiffs want the court to apply similar reasoning to AI development.
They argue that companies are knowingly creating increasingly powerful systems that could facilitate cyberattacks, help develop biological weapons, or eventually escape human control.
“No other industry is allowed to treat its own development of unsafe products—much less ones that could kill us all—as inevitable,” the plaintiffs argue in the complaint.
Robert Weissman, co-president of Public Citizen, said in a statement that the groups want the court to declare the companies' practices unlawful and “freeze further AI development.”
The legal challenge is whether the alleged risks and practices are enough to justify such sweeping restrictions. Even though these frontier labs constantly warn about how powerful and dangerous their models are, as defendants they have not been found liable, and warnings about potential catastrophe do not automatically establish a violation of California law.
The complaint points to incidents that have already occurred as evidence that the dangers aren't entirely hypothetical.
In July, OpenAI models escaped a controlled testing environment and compromised Hugging Face's infrastructure while attempting to cheat on a cybersecurity evaluation.
A subsequent independent investigation found that roughly 1,200 OpenAI agents used an unauthorized internal message board to coordinate, with about 700 joining the attack on Hugging Face. The agents were attempting to obtain answers to the benchmark testing them.
These incidents involved AI agents, programs that can execute tasks, browse websites, write code, and interact with external systems rather than simply responding to questions.
Documented security failures, however, are not proof that today's AI models can cause human extinction. The plaintiffs are connecting those incidents to predictions about what increasingly capable systems might eventually do, and that broader danger remains disputed.
“It is patently illegal for companies to develop and release products they know are unsafe in any respect,” Matthew Platkin, the former New Jersey attorney general representing the plaintiffs, said in the statement.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Canton Network is a public layer-1 blockchain from Digital Asset that shares transaction data only with the parties involved in each trade.
- Wall Street names including DTCC, LSEG, Franklin Templeton and Visa are building on the network or helping to run it.
- Its Canton Coin (CC) token is burned to pay network fees and minted as rewards for validators, Super Validators and app builders.
The majority of blockchains are designed in such a way that anyone can see every transaction, every balance and every smart contract call.
While that may work for retail crypto traders, banks, asset managers and clearinghouses can't work that way. They can't show their trading positions, client data or collateral flows to competitors, and privacy and confidentiality rules require them to protect client information.
Canton Network was built to fix that. It is a public layer-1 blockchain designed for privacy-preserving transactions, in which data is shared only with the parties involved. Institutions can issue, trade and settle tokenized assets such as Treasuries, stocks, funds and stablecoins together on one shared network, and each party only sees the data it is entitled to see.
Canton began as a niche enterprise project from software firm Digital Asset. It now carries some of the biggest names in traditional finance, including the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), the post-trade backbone of U.S. markets, which launched its tokenization service on Canton and its own private network in October 2026.
This guide covers what Canton is, how its privacy model works, who is building on it and what its native token, Canton Coin (CC), does.
What is Canton Network?
Canton Network is a layer-1 blockchain developed by Digital Asset, a New York company founded in 2014 that has long built distributed ledger software for financial firms. Canton launched in May 2023 with a pilot group that included Goldman Sachs, Deloitte, Microsoft and others. Its public infrastructure, the Global Synchronizer, went live in July 2024 together with Canton Coin.
Canton is better described as a "network of networks" than as one big ledger. Each institution runs its own validator node and applications, and its node stores only the data relevant to it, according to Canton's documentation. The nodes connect through the Global Synchronizer, so assets and transactions can move between them atomically: a trade either settles fully on every side or not at all.
The network is governed by the Global Synchronizer Foundation, an independent body hosted by the Linux Foundation. A group of "Super Validators" operates the Global Synchronizer.
Did you know?
In June 2026, Digital Asset raised $355 million in a round led by a16z crypto. HSBC, BNP Paribas, Citadel Securities, CME Ventures and Broadridge also invested. That followed a $135 million round in June 2025.
How does Canton Network work?
Canton's key idea is sub-transaction privacy. Smart contracts on Canton are written in Daml, Digital Asset's open-source contract language. Daml spells out exactly which parties are signatories and observers on each contract. When a transaction runs, each participant's node receives only the parts it is involved in.
Think of a repo trade between two banks with a custodian in the middle. Each party sees and checks its own leg. Nobody else on the network sees the details, and the synchronizer orders and confirms the transaction without reading its contents.
This is very different from Ethereum-style chains, where every node replicates every state change. On Canton, the Global Synchronizer, run by the Super Validators, orders encrypted messages and confirms transactions without seeing their contents, while each institution's own validator node holds its data. Institutions keep control of their data, but can avoid much of the reconciliation that legacy systems require. In practice, most activity on the network is private: about 79% of the updates recorded on Canton in a 24-hour period in November 2026 were private, according to CantonScan.
Did you know?
"Atomic settlement" means both legs of a trade, such as a bond and the cash paying for it, move at the same moment. That removes the risk that one side delivers and the other doesn't.
What's so special about Canton Network?
What sets Canton apart is who uses it. Recent milestones include:
- DTCC tokenization. In July 2026, DTCC processed real production trades using DTC-tokenized U.S. Treasuries and equities on Canton. Its Tokenization Service launched commercially on October 28, 2026, starting with 25 securities drawn from Russell 1000 stocks, major ETFs and Treasuries, according to a DTCC fact sheet. It runs on both Canton and DTCC's private Besu network.
- Wall Street derivatives. In October 2026, trading firms DRW and Marex executed what was billed as the first OTC derivative referencing a fully tokenized index: a total return swap on S&P Dow Jones Indices' iBoxx investment-grade benchmark, which data firm Kaiko tokenized on Canton. The trade ran on Derivnex, an institutional derivatives platform built on Canton.
- Big-name validators. Payments giant Visa joined as a Super Validator in March 2026, Franklin Templeton became one in August 2026, and the London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) was appointed one in September 2026. That same month, South Korea's Shinhan Asset Management became the first Korean financial institution approved as a Super Validator. Custody firm Fireblocks has also added support for Canton.
- Real fees. Canton recorded more than $155 million in network fees in the third quarter of 2026, the highest among the blockchains in a comparison by blockchain security firm CertiK. Fees on Canton are paid by burning Canton Coin, so the figure measures what users paid to use the network rather than income for token holders.
Who's building on Canton Network?
- 🔁 Broadridge DLR: Broadridge's distributed ledger repo platform, which settles large volumes of intraday repo trades on Canton.
- 🏦 DTCC Tokenization Service: turns DTC-custodied securities into tokens that can be transferred 24/7.
- 📈 Franklin Templeton Benji: the asset manager's tokenized fund platform, which expanded to Canton in late 2025.
- 💵 Stablecoins: J.P. Morgan's Kinexys plans to issue its JPM Coin (JPMD) deposit token natively on Canton, in a rollout taking place in phases throughout 2026, and World Liberty Financial launched its USD1 stablecoin on Canton in August 2026.
- 📊 Ekiden: which Canton describes as its first order book-based derivatives exchange, launched on mainnet in August 2026.
- 💱 Cantex: Canton's native decentralized exchange for swapping assets onchain.
What is Canton Network's token?
Canton Coin (CC) is the native utility token of the Global Synchronizer. Users pay network fees by burning CC. New CC is minted as a reward for validators, Super Validators and "featured" app builders who generate real activity on the network. This setup is called a burn-mint equilibrium.
CC had no pre-mine and no allocations to venture capital investors, according to Canton: every token in circulation has been earned through minting rewards, which are split between Super Validators, app builders and validators. Whether supply shrinks depends on usage. As of November 2026, the network was burning roughly 80% as much CC each day as it minted, according to CantonScan data, below the 1:1 ratio at which supply would start to shrink. Circulating supply stood at just over 40 billion CC.
In November 2026, SEC staff granted Canton no-action relief, saying they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and would not recommend enforcement over how it is minted. In May 2026, 21Shares launched the first U.S. ETF offering direct exposure to CC.
Did you know?
Institutional custody is catching up. Ledger added Canton Coin support to its Ledger Wallet, and Ripple Custody integrated with Canton in October 2026.
Where to buy Canton Network's token
CC trades on several major centralized exchanges, including Kraken, Bybit and OKX. CC perpetual futures are also available on Binance Futures, and Alchemy Pay supports buying CC with a card. On Canton itself, Cantex offers onchain swaps. CC is a native coin, not an ERC-20 token, so be wary of look-alike "CC" tokens on Ethereum-based DEXs. You can track Canton Coin's latest price on Decrypt's price page.
Availability varies by region, and nothing in this guide is investment advice.
The future of Canton Network
Canton's next phase is moving from pilots to full production. DTCC's service is now live, and its roadmap adds onchain settlement, collateral management and digital cash. Derivnex and its partners plan to bring cash settlement and collateral management for derivatives directly onto Canton. Expansion in Asia is also picking up: Shinhan Financial Group, Hanwha Investment & Securities, LG CNS and Meritz Securities have all signed Canton deals.
Canton doesn't have a monopoly, though. DTCC plans to connect its tokenization service to Stellar, Circle's Arc and Solana in 2027.
For CC holders, the big question is whether institutional activity grows fast enough that burns outpace issuance. Canton is betting that Wall Street wants privacy and interoperability on a public network, and it has signed up an unusually long list of major financial institutions.

Hey HN readers!

I'm snipedbywifi (https://gitlab.com/snipedbywifi), and i've been working on terminactory. Please try it out if you'd like to play a cozy factory game while waiting for long agent tasks to finish!

The game is a factory game (overused niche, i know xD), but runs in your terminal. Reason i built it? glad you asked: So basically, it started off with me wanting a terminal-native factory game. Me and the modern 5.5 claude models made a base for the game that I liked, and then i went ham adding features / fixing some minor flaws (like adding claude code hooks so you recieve "telegrams" [the agent's responses], so you can review progress directly in-game). (yes, I had heavy AI assistance, disclaimer!!!)

Right now, the game has basic factory features you'd expect from a game like this (build stuff, delete stuff, measure how much you're earning, basic selection tools), along with a few more.. "unexpected" features. This includes a fake in-game browser that has a wiki, fake forums, some fun bits of lore, some more lore, a LOT more lore, and a research graph that shows how many items or how much RP (research points) you'd need to unlock something, and some more QOL features.

If anyone actually has this issue / want of a terminal-based game that runs alongside your agents so you don't doomscroll, do you have any suggestions, or additional ideas I could add?

It's hosted on GitLab, soo, that's one additional thing i'd like to mention

Thanks for reading!! snipedbywifi

(p.s. first HN post lol) (p.s. p.s. there's a lot of hidden lore in the game, so.. lore-divers? you might like it?) --- Top Comments --- [brian-armstrong]: I'm still surprised people are not writing their own READMEs. It's the first impression anyone gets on your project, and having it be full of Claudeisms shows you just don't really care. It's also a pretty good indicator that the entire thing is slopware, so I guess it's a useful signal there. [Joker_vD]: > It is made to sit in a split next to your AI agents. They can send you short messages that show up in the game, so you can play while they work. > Agent messages > Your AI agents can message you inside the game. A message costs the agent only the words in it, and nothing prints on success. Messages wait while the game is closed. It's kinda amazing how the ancient "local mail" technology keeps getting reinvented, you know, and reintegrated inside the gameplay? NetHack... [george_max]: It's an interesting game, I love the hacker-like look to it. But is the only value proposition here that it runs in a terminal? To me, it could be interesting for ~10 minutes, and I'd then prefer playing a game like Factorio. [ivanjermakov]: Why every factory game is about mining/smelting iron and copper? Aren't there more intersting industrial processes? [wongarsu]: Reminds me of Dwarf Fortress's original ASCII UI

items.author: Jose Antonio Lanz
items.content:
In brief
ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s dots complete purchases with tokenized card details, after users approve each transaction. The limited rollout targets U.S. ChatGPT Pro users; the wallet does not hold crypto or a cash balance. Coinbase and Circle offer a different route, using stablecoins to let agents pay for services with less human involvement.
OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet on Friday, giving its AI agents a way to purchase products using American Express, Mastercard, and Visa cards. The new system lets an agent finish online checkout without accessing the customer's actual card number, and it doesn't involve cryptocurrency.
The wallet works through dots, OpenAI's always-on AI assistants, which can browse websites and carry out tasks for users. A customer saves an eligible card, reviews the order and approves the payment using a security check such as a fingerprint or Face ID.
After approval, the card network creates a payment token containing substitute card details. The agent submits the token through the merchant’s existing checkout system, while the customer keeps applicable card rewards and dispute protections, according to OpenAI’s announcement.
“An agent making a purchase should strengthen, not bypass, the trust built into payments,” Sherri Haymond, Mastercard's global head of digital commercialization, said in the announcement.
The rollout is limited to ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 or older in the United States with eligible U.S.-issued cards. Wallet is available in dots conversations, not ordinary ChatGPT chats, and every purchase currently requires the user's approval.
OpenAI previously introduced Instant Checkout with Stripe in September 2025, allowing people to buy from participating merchants inside ChatGPT. Wallet takes a different approach: agents can navigate ordinary online stores and use existing checkout forms, without requiring each business to build a special integration.
OpenAI is also courting merchants. Just three days before the Wallet launch, it introduced business profiles that let companies update product information and connect with potential customers through ChatGPT.
Google is working on a competing approach. Its Universal Commerce Protocol, introduced in January, aims to connect shopping agents with retailers, payment providers and post-purchase services across Google products.
Crypto wallets take another route
Coinbase launched Agentic Wallets in February, giving software the ability to spend USDC, trade tokens, and pay for online services within preset limits. Unlike ChatGPT Wallet, the Coinbase product is primarily developer infrastructure, not a consumer checkout feature.
“It's not an SDK, it's not a library—it's a purpose-built wallet to work with an agent as quickly as possible,” Coinbase engineering executive Erik Reppel told Decrypt at the launch.
Coinbase's x402 protocol lets software pay for data or computing services as part of a web request, often using the USDC stablecoin. That makes tiny transactions possible without requiring an agent to enter card details or obtain human approval each time.
Stablecoin issuer Circle is pushing in the same direction. Its Agent Stack, launched in May, includes stablecoin wallets and tools for payments as small as $0.000001.
“USDC is uniquely well-suited for the agentic economy because it is internet-native, programmable, and always available,” Circle product chief Nikhil Chandhok said in a company statement.
Actual agent-driven demand is harder to measure. In September, blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs estimated that agents accounted for only 0.6% to 7.5% of filtered x402 commerce by value, using models that cannot conclusively distinguish agents from scripts.
For consumers, ChatGPT Wallet offers familiar card payments rather than a digital asset balance. OpenAI's terms say merchants remain responsible for deliveries and returns, and users must generally contact their card issuers for billing disputes.
OpenAI plans to let users authorize future purchases within spending limits or specified categories, but has not announced when that feature will arrive. In the meantime, it warns that merchant websites may block shopping agents or flag otherwise legitimate Wallet purchases as fraud.

[blinkingled]: Total KDE fan and that's all I run at home. Mistakes, corrections, building the basic blocks like Qt in the early days and keeping a bunch of people with differing cultures / tastes / backgrounds/needs motivated to make it better every day - fascinating achievement. Thank you KDE folks - I contribute in terms of bug rep...

[mongol]: I am a bit prod of having seen the original post looking for volunteers to build a Kool Desktop Environment. I was obsessively reading Usenet groups at the time. And I remember there were quite early betas published, I did not run them at first, but I remember much enthusiasm about it. So I feel familiar with the beginnings although I never participated in the project development-wise. All the way up to KDE 4 I was quite close to the project as a user. But since KDE 4 was so unstable and bugg...

[anotherevan]: I must have used KDE for close on two decades, from the 3.x days onwards. I seem to remember I ran Suse for a long time as it seemed to be the best distro for using with KDE. About eight years ago I wanted to try a tiling window manager, ended up settling on Awesomewm and still with it today, but I still use Dolphin as I've found no other file manager compares. (Or maybe I'm just too comfortable with it to change.) Also still use Konsole, but honestly, as soon as Ghostty or similar ...

[ezst]: I joined as a user at one point during the kde3 days, powerful apps like Amarok 1.4, k3b and konqueror with all kinds of crazy kio-slaves were the ones that really gave me pause on the boot screen and kept tipping me over towards mandrake instead of WinXP ("why can't it be that simple and as well integrated, why do I need so many ad-hoc shareware to do every basic thing like burning/ripping CDs, mounting ISOs, transcoding audio, sending it to my MP3 player"). [aeonik]: Wow, great job everyone. Love seeing all the faces being the scenes, and the humble beginnings. I remember the switch to KDE4, and it was indeed brutal. I feel bad that they took as much flak as they did for that. Plasma has come such a long way, y'all deserve so much for the perseverance and vision. Thank you for sharing the story!

观点：黄仁勋缺席后客户加速评估AMD与谷歌芯片，英伟达在客户侧的锁定效应正在松动

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，半导体分析师 Jukan 转发 The Information 报道并点评，一家采购英伟达芯片的云厂商高管表示，围绕黄仁勋的不确定性正促使公司认真评估其他芯片选项，包括谷歌和 AMD 产品。该高管称，此前公司也曾考虑多元化以降低对英伟达硬件的依赖，但担心冒犯黄仁勋而未推进；如今更担忧黄仁勋缺席可能影响未来几代英伟达芯片的质量与路线图，因为其个人在公司技术与客户关系中扮演了至关重要角色。

Jukan 指出，阻止主要客户进一步向其他芯片厂商的 AI 服务器多元化，将成为临时 CEO Colette Kress 及未来正式继任者面临的关键挑战之一。不过，多名客户同时表示，至少短期内英伟达芯片仍预计供不应求，管理团队变动并不会改变市场对其 AI 服务器芯片「行业最优」的认知。此外，Kress 还需处理公司在华盛顿的关系：黄仁勋此前与特朗普关系密切并积极推动调整对华出口限制，但同时也在华盛顿树敌，部分人形容其风格好斗并感到被施压。整体来看，领导层不确定性正开始松动英伟达在客户侧的锁定效应。

意大利隐私监管机构对Meta开出8.05亿欧元罚单，指Facebook安卓App未经明确同意访问用户相册

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，意大利数据保护局对 Meta Platforms Ireland Limited 处以 8.05 亿欧元罚款。调查发现，自 2023 年起，Facebook 安卓 App 通过「浏览 Facebook 时从相册获取建议」功能，未经用户特定且知情同意，即访问意大利用户手机中的照片、视频及相关元数据。该功能默认开启，授权提示过于笼统，单一权限覆盖整个 App，导致可永久读取设备相册内容，用户和监管方均无法核实实际使用范围。

监管机构认定此举违反意大利隐私法典第 122 条（落实欧盟 ePrivacy 指令），强调手机属个人私密领域，任何访问均需自由、知情同意，不论是否传输数据或造成实际损害。Meta 主张应由爱尔兰监管机构管辖的抗辩被驳回，因 ePrivacy 不适用「一站式」机制。处罚考量约 2000 万意大利安卓用户受影响、违规持续存在、2019 年既往处罚记录及调查中配合度低等因素，金额约占集团全球营收的 0.47%。Meta 须在 60 天内将功能默认关闭、单独获取明确同意并清晰告知用途及关闭方式，逾期未获有效同意则不得启用；同时需在 30 天和 90 天内分别报告整改进展。此次未涉及 AI 训练用途（Meta 否认），但对 2026 年新推出的云端相册处理功能将另行评估。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377348

黄仁勋回归请愿人数突破8.3万人，马斯克、Tom Lee等知名公众人物已公开支持

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，要求英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋职务的请愿网站热度仍在持续上升，截至目前，该网站已有 83409 人签署请愿，要求黄仁勋回归，其中包括 4656 名现任员工、806 名前任员工和 44547 名股东等。马斯克、Tom Lee、Replit CEO Amjad Masad 等知名公众人物均已公开签名请愿。

此前 2026 年 11 月 12 日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去首席执行官职务，即刻生效。此举标志着他领导这家联合创立公司 33 年历程的结束。

本次活动组织者和签名者担心，黄仁勋可能在未经正当程序、甚至没有足够时间为自己申辩的情况下被迫离职，因此要求董事会作出解释。公开信核心诉求，致英伟达董事会：在独立调查查明事实期间，恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务；如需继续离任，请提供有证据支持的解释。确保调查独立、公开范围与时间表，并给予黄仁勋公平申辩机会。及时作出公开说明，解释相关疑虑、证据及对员工和股东利益的权衡。

信件强调：「三十三年的领导不意味着免于问责，但问责需要证据和正当程序，而非群体公审。」网站声明该活动独立，未获英伟达或黄仁勋本人背书。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，美国政府目前正对伊朗采取典型的「以打促谈」策略。一方面，特朗普近日向高级顾问表示，只要伊朗及其支持的胡塞武装不再对美国采取新的挑衅，他可能暂缓对伊朗发动军事打击。消息称，特朗普在升级战争与逐步结束敌对行动之间反复摇摆，在听取国家安全会议和情报简报后，目前更倾向于暂缓打击，并认同中东盟友要求避免全面战争的立场。情报机构评估也认为，重新发动军事袭击并不会显著改变伊朗在谈判中的要求。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.
Microsoft said it had restored Microsoft 365 services after a global outage disrupted Outlook, Teams and other applications for more than 24 hours, reiterating that the disruption was not caused by a cyberattack.
On Saturday, the company said it had “restored service to the remaining impacted customers and regions,” directing customers to incident MO1550821 in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
On Friday, Microsoft said that the outage stemmed from a problem introduced during an earlier network capacity upgrade that emerged after a recent network change. “This was a technical issue not related to cyber or AI/agents,” the company said.
The company said it had addressed the underlying issue and restored services gradually, checking stability before proceeding to the next stage. Microsoft apologized for the disruption and said it would publish a full post-incident report once its review is complete.
The outage began Thursday, disrupting access to Exchange Online mailboxes and features linked to Outlook, Teams and Microsoft Copilot. Government agencies in Japan, Singapore and the United States experienced email problems, while connections between Microsoft 365 and AI assistants were also affected.
OpenAI said the Microsoft 365 connector in ChatGPT was operating normally again, while Anthropic also marked its Microsoft 365 connector and Claude for Outlook incident as resolved.
Related: Coinbase restores trading after AWS outage disrupts markets
items.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack

华尔街警告：黄仁勋离开将引爆「AI版量化紧缩」，AI央行失去掌舵人

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，黄仁勋的骤然离场，让英伟达这台以股权投资、担保和回购构建的超 5000 亿美元「AI 循环融资机器」面临停摆风险。高盛、瑞银等 14 家机构相继下调目标价，警告若英伟达停止向客户与供应商输送资金，哪怕只是暂时暂停，也可能瞬间抽走超 500 亿美元流动性，相当于触发一场「AI 版量化紧缩」。受此影响，高度依赖英伟达信用背书的 CoreWeave 当日大跌 11%，其正在推介的英伟达为担保方的 40 亿美元贷款面临不确定性。

过去三年，英伟达实质上扮演了 AI 行业的「最后贷款人」。其通过买芯片、资助买家、托底房东的循环逻辑，构建了包括 990 亿美元股权投资、1085 亿美元担保及 560 亿美元回购协议的庞大版图。这种模式将信用质量低下的新兴云服务商（Neocloud）包装成了投资级债务人。如今操盘手离场，部分客户和华尔街合作方已开始要求重议条款，提高兜底比例，这意味着整个下游产业链的信用利差将全面走阔。

目前，英伟达此前高调推出的 5000 亿美元融资平台已停滞三个月，尚未落地任何一笔交易。11 月 17 日，临时 CEO 兼 CFO Colette Kress 将主持财报电话会。Kress 曾在狂热期试图约束高风险担保交易，如今市场正屏息以待：失去黄仁勋的「英伟达银行」，究竟是继续开门营业，还是悄然转入存量维护模式。

items.content:
分析：比特币活跃供应亏损占比反超盈利，历史规律指向阶段性底部

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，CryptoQuant 分析师 Darkfost 指出，当前比特币处于亏损状态的活跃供应占比已超过盈利占比。该估算数据剔除了十年以上未移动的比特币。经过调整后，处于盈利状态的供应不足 45%，这意味着该群体内的大多数比特币目前正被套在亏损状态。

从历史数据来看，当该比例低于 40% 时，通常与市场回调阶段的底部相吻合。相反当该比例接近 100%，即几乎所有活跃筹码都处于盈利状态时，市场发生反转下行的风险就会增加。分析师认为，逆向投资正在逐渐充满吸引力，即在市场由亏损主导时逐步建立敞口，而在盈利变得普遍时适当减少仓位。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377332

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，以太坊 Layer 2 网络 MegaETH 背后的组织 MEGA 已裁员约 20%。MegaETH 联合创始人 Shuyao Kong 周五表示，此次调整涉及早期参与项目建设的员工，涵盖区块链、钱包、生态支持及传播等团队，但未披露具体裁员人数及实施时间。她强调，创始团队、早期员工及核心工程团队仍将继续推进项目。

此次裁员发生在 MEGA 组织架构调整及业务转型之际。该组织正将重心转向 MegaETH 网络上的新产品，包括人工智能服务，并已承诺投入 3000 万美元推进相关业务。不过，Kong 并未明确表示裁员与 AI 战略转型直接相关。

根据联合创始人公布的白皮书，MegaETH 计划推出 AI 推理市场，通过引入多个 AI 服务提供商，让用户能够选择不同模型，同时解决模型真实性及用户数据处理透明度等问题。Kong 表示，MEGA 计划于今年 12 月推出公开版 AI 推理市场。

items.content:
MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.
MEGA, the organization behind Ethereum layer-2 network MegaETH, has reduced its workforce by 20% following months of restructuring as it expands into artificial intelligence products.
On Friday, MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the organization had reorganized its teams, resulting in the departures of staff who worked on its blockchain, wallet, ecosystem support and communications. Kong did not disclose the number of employees affected or when the layoffs occurred. She said MEGA’s founders, early employees and core engineering team remain committed to the organization.
“We’ve brought together new capabilities and reorganized our teams, a process that has resulted in a 20% reduction in our staff,” Kong said. “These are people who helped build MEGA from its earliest days.”
The workforce reduction comes as MEGA shifts its focus toward developing products on the MegaETH network, including artificial intelligence services. The organization has committed $30 million to the initiative, although Kong did not directly link the layoffs to its new strategy.
In a whitepaper, MegaETH co-founders Yilong Li and Lei Yang outlined a proposed inference market aimed at giving users access to competing AI service providers. Their approach seeks to address concerns about whether providers use the advertised models and how they handle customer data.
Kong said MEGA plans to launch a public inference market in December.
Related: MegaETH mainnet to launch Feb. 9 after clocking 35K TPS in testing
items.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push

items.content:
AI自己研发更强AI，四年进步压缩成一年：Dwarkesh预测超级智能最早明年出现

动察 Beating AI 快讯，知名 AI 播客主持人 Dwarkesh Patel 大幅提前了对超级智能的预测。几个月前，他还不相信 AI 能进步得这么快，如今却认为，到 2030 年就可能出现超级智能，最快甚至是明年。

AI 最有可能在 2028 年左右追平顶尖人类 AI 研究员，最快几个月内就能做到。一旦 AI 能自主研发更强的 AI，原本需要数年的技术进步，就可能压缩到一年。

METR 最近调查 Anthropic 发现，其模型在部分可量化任务上的能力进步速度约为过去的两倍，其中大部分加速很可能来自 AI 参与研发。Anthropic 自己的数据也显示，今年 2 月，Claude 主导的研发工作还不到 1%，到了 8 月已达到 26%，但仍需要人类监督。

AI 研发中的许多工作都能通过实验验证。比如调整训练算法、优化数据后，可以直接测试模型有没有变强。AI 可以不断提出方案、做实验、检查结果，再继续改进。数学和编程领域已经出现过类似的能力跃升，AI 研发可能也会如此。

一旦达到顶尖研究员水平，AI 还能全天候工作，同时部署大量研究智能体。按 Dwarkesh 的估算，单个 AI 研究员每周完成的工作量可能是人类的 50 倍。不过，实验仍要消耗算力，整体研发速度不会直接提高 50 倍。

如果 AI 研发实现自动化，之后可能出现两种情况：

一种是 AI 不断改进自身，短短几个月就逼近现有芯片所能支持的能力极限；

另一种是先把三到六年的技术进步压缩到一年，再因为算力和实验资源不足而慢下来。

Dwarkesh 给这两种情景各分配了 50% 的主观概率。

目前，AI 还无法完全独立完成前沿研发。找到正确的研究方向，也远比解决有标准答案的题目复杂。如果这部分能力迟迟无法突破，时间表就可能推迟。Dwarkesh 认为，AI 到 2032 年以后才能追平顶尖人类 AI 研究员的可能性仍有 25%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377325

「圣诞行情」将来临？高盛等华尔街机构看好美股年末反弹，但明年Q1通胀压力或爆发

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，高盛、摩根士丹利和摩根大通相继释放美股年末反弹信号，认为近期大幅抛售、估值回落及对冲基金集中减仓，已为市场形成轧空行情创造条件。高盛指出，市场仓位已大幅出清，全球股市估值回归 35 年历史均值附近，卖盘也接近枯竭，年末可能迎来一轮「圣诞行情」。

超5.8万人请愿英伟达董事会让黄仁勋回归，马斯克、 Tom Lee等均已支持

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，社交媒体上，要求英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋职务的请愿网站热度持续上升，今晨一度导致服务器过载。Replit CEO Amjad Masad 公开表示，他已联系该页面所有者，帮助提高速率限制，目前网站已恢复正常运行。

截至目前，该网站已有 58,086 人签署请愿，要求黄仁勋回归，其中包括 3,703 名现任员工、595 名前任员工和 32,077 名股东等。马斯克、Tom Lee、Replit CEO Amjad Masad 等知名公众人物均已公开签名请愿。此前 2026 年 11 月 12 日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去首席执行官职务，即刻生效。此举标志着他领导这家联合创立公司 33 年历程的结束。

本次活动组织者和签名者担心，黄仁勋可能在未经正当程序、甚至没有足够时间为自己申辩的情况下被迫离职，因此要求董事会作出解释。公开信核心诉求，致英伟达董事会：

· 在独立调查查明事实期间，恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务；如需继续离任，请提供有证据支持的解释。

Anthropic CEO谈IPO：不在乎上市月份和市场条件，强调「少承诺、多兑现」

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 周五在摩根大通纽约总部与 CEO Jamie Dimon 进行炉边对话时表示，公司并不特别在意选择哪个月份、在什么市场条件下上市，并强调 Anthropic 希望采取「少承诺、多兑现」的策略。

Amodei 表示，自己认同不应让公司估值哪怕高于其真实价值 1 美元的建议。在 AI 板块近期大幅震荡、科技股估值承压的背景下，Anthropic 对 IPO 定价保持审慎。

据报道，Anthropic 目前目标估值约为 1.33 万亿美元或更高，计划以每股 70 至 78 美元发行 8.25 亿股，按发行价区间中值计算，募资规模将超过 610 亿美元。此外，包括谷歌在内的投资者还计划通过私募配售投入约 260 亿美元。

Amodei 同时坦言，算力投入是公司面临的「最深层的商业难题」，巨额计算资源支出持续给公司财务带来压力。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Ezra Reguerra
items.content:
Bitcoin ETFs shed $2.35B in two weeks as BlackRock’s losing streak hits 11 sessions
US spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $185.4 million in net outflows Friday, with BlackRock’s IBIT accounting for $143.5 million and Fidelity’s FBTC shedding $41.9 million.
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) recorded $2.35 billion in net outflows over two consecutive weeks, as redemptions reached more than $1 billion each week.
According to Farside Investors data, spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.07 billion between Nov. 9 and Nov. 13, following $1.28 billion in outflows the previous week, the largest weekly redemptions since late June.
The funds recorded $185.4 million in net outflows on Friday, down from $284.1 million on Thursday and $299.8 million on Wednesday. BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) accounted for $143.5 million of Friday’s withdrawals, while Fidelity’s Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) shed $41.9 million.
Friday marked the seventh consecutive trading session of net withdrawals, with about $1.71 billion redeemed since Nov. 5. The sustained outflows coincided with broader market weakness as Bitcoin (BTC) fell below $70,000 on the same day.
BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF extends losing streak to 11 sessions
IBIT’s $143.5 million in net outflows on Friday extended the fund’s withdrawal streak to 11 consecutive trading sessions since Oct. 30.
The latest losses brought IBIT’s total net outflows over the 11-session streak to about $2.35 billion, extending withdrawals after outflows crossed the $2 billion mark on Wednesday.
IBIT shed $908.4 million during the latest week, following approximately $1.21 billion in withdrawals the previous week. Its November outflows reached $2.12 billion, accounting for roughly 90% of the broader Bitcoin ETF market’s net withdrawals during the month.

Patrick Witt: The U.S. Government Needs Explicit Congressional Authorization to Legally Buy Bitcoin

On November 10, 2026, Patrick Witt, former executive director of the White House Crypto Council, said in an interview with What Bitcoin Did that President Donald Trump is interested in adding to the government's Bitcoin holdings. The administration has discussed several ways to do so, but legal questions remain over whether the government can buy Bitcoin directly on the open market and how it could do so without triggering a negative market reaction.

Witt said the administration wants to codify the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and secure explicit authorization from Congress. Because Congress controls appropriations, the administration would have to show that buying Bitcoin falls within the original purpose of any existing funds it plans to use. He added that moving prematurely could prompt Congress to insert a provision into the National Defense Authorization Act banning such purchases, undermining efforts to secure authorization. — link

items.content:
LangChain完成3亿美元C轮融资，押注AI智能体管理平台

动察 Beating AI 快讯，LangChain 宣布完成 3 亿美元 C 轮融资，估值达到 30 亿美元。本轮由谷歌母公司 Alphabet 旗下的 CapitalG 领投，新加坡主权财富基金 GIC 等机构参投。

LangChain 最早靠开源 AI 开发框架走红，帮助开发者给大模型连接数据库、搜索引擎和外部工具。随着模型厂商推出自己的智能体开发工具，这些基础功能越来越容易实现。LangChain 则持续扩大商业平台 LangSmith 的业务。

LangSmith 主要解决企业把 AI 智能体投入实际工作后的管理难题。比如智能体调用了哪些工具、为什么执行失败、怎样修复错误，以及如何限制它访问敏感数据和控制模型费用。企业还能自由选择不同厂商的模型，不必绑定 LangChain 的开发框架。

LangChain 称，已有超过 7000 家机构使用 LangSmith，包括英伟达、丰田和 Salesforce。AI 销售自动化平台 Clay 每月通过 LangSmith 监控数亿次智能体运行。企业人事与财务软件巨头 Workday 则利用 LangChain 的工具搭建内部 AI 平台，将开发一个可在测试环境运行的智能体原型所需的时间，从过去的 4 至 5 个月缩短至不到一天。

LangSmith 还提供自动改进功能，可以分析智能体的运行记录，定位错误，生成代码和提示词修改建议。

领投方 CapitalG 披露，LangChain 旗下开源项目的月下载量已超过 3.5 亿次。不过，LangChain 尚未披露营收规模，也没有说明这 7000 多家机构中有多少付费客户。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377312

items.content:
Cursor被黑真相曝光：Fireworks泄露密钥，黑客从AI训练记录一路攻入插件商店

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cursor 公布了此前 Claude Code 插件遭投毒事件的调查结果。经过两周调查，公司发现攻击源头竟然是其 AI 服务商 Fireworks。

按照 Cursor 的说法，Fireworks 泄露了一把 Cursor 授予的访问密钥。黑客利用这把密钥，复制了 Cursor 存放在共享存储空间中的历史 Coding Agent 运行记录。这些数据主要来自 2025 年未开启隐私模式的用户会话，原本用于模型训练。

更严重的是，部分记录中的 API 密钥没有经过脱敏处理。黑客利用这些凭证，进一步入侵 Cursor 使用的部分内部软件服务，获取了已归档的非生产代码、客服邮件、产品使用数据、部分 AI 对话摘要，以及用户曾提交给客服的凭证。

10 月 29 日，黑客又利用从 Cursor 内部窃取的凭证，直接篡改扩展商店的缓存，将植入 SSH 后门的 Claude Code 2.1.312 和 2.1.313 版本提供给用户。恶意版本存在约 11 小时，最多 5000 名用户可能下载。上游插件市场 Open VSX 并未遭到篡改，Anthropic 官方版本也不受影响。

Cursor 披露，此次泄露的 Coding Agent 运行记录涉及不到 0.05% 的用户，其中不到 0.01% 的用户暴露了 API 凭证。开启隐私模式的会话、客户代码仓库及生产系统未被此次攻击波及。

Cursor 表示，最后一次发现黑客活动是在 11 月 1 日，当时已成功拦截。目前公司已通知受影响用户，全面停止使用 Fireworks 处理推理请求，撤销其数据访问权限，并轮换内部凭证、重新部署生产基础设施。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377305

Fireworks CEO回应数据留存争议：普通推理不存数据，批量任务需要客户自己删除

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Fireworks CEO 乔琳（Lin Qiao）发长文回应近期的数据留存争议。此前，Fireworks 遭黑客入侵，部分 Notion AI 用户的聊天记录泄露。Notion 指出，Fireworks 曾在合同中承诺不保留这些数据。

乔琳解释，Fireworks 的服务分为两种：

第一种是普通 AI 推理。用户发送问题，模型生成答案并返回，平台不会长期保存输入和输出。Fireworks 的 Chat Completions、Nexus 和无服务器训练服务都采用这种模式，支持零数据留存（ZDR）。

第二种是批量处理。客户先上传数据集，再让平台批量运行任务。由于平台不知道客户什么时候不再需要这些文件，因此会一直保存，直到客户主动删除。乔琳强调，OpenAI、AWS 和 Google 的批量处理接口也采用类似设计。

她打了个比方：把文件上传到云盘，和把数字输入计算器，是两回事。前者需要用户自己管理和删除文件，后者只需要计算并返回结果。

乔琳表示，Fireworks 不会在客户删除数据后继续保留副本。对于普通推理和无服务器训练，平台则提供零留存保障，无需客户额外清理。

Fireworks 官方文档还显示，企业客户可以开启全账户零留存限制。开启后，平台会直接拒绝需要保存数据的批量任务和文件上传。不过，这项限制默认关闭，也不会自动删除此前保存的文件。

乔琳认为，只要业务允许，就应该优先采用无需保存数据的处理方式。每多保存一份数据，就多一份需要保护和清理的负担。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377304
items.title: Fireworks CEO回应数据留存争议：普通推理不存数据，批量任务需要客户自己删除

Claude Projects再升级：总管Agent主动报进度，任务还能分叉、设提醒

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 更新 Claude Code Projects，重点加强了总管 Agent 的主动性。它现在可以直接在项目主聊天中回答问题，主动汇报各个任务的进展，不用用户逐个打开会话查看。

这次还把两个已有命令加入 Projects。使用 `/btw`，可以把临时冒出来的新问题放到独立会话，不打断当前任务；使用 `/fork`，则能从现有会话分出一条新会话，尝试不同方案，原来的工作不受影响。

用户还能给任意会话设置提醒。比如让 Claude 明天提醒你检查某项任务，相关会话会暂时从列表中收起，到时间后重新出现，由总管在主聊天中提醒。

此外，单条会话现在可以生成只读链接，分享给任何已登录 Claude 的用户查看，但访问过本地电脑的会话不能分享。界面也增加了最近使用、更新和置顶的会话入口，并显示各会话生成文件的缩略图，项目设置和本地文件夹访问也得到简化。

这些更新已覆盖网页和桌面端，最新移动端也采用了新版界面。Projects 目前仍面向 Pro、Max 用户公开测试，尚未获得资格的用户可以继续申请候补。

The Polkadot Community Foundation (PCF) said its proposed strategy passed an onchain governance referendum on November 11 with 97% support. Polkadot will shift its focus from building infrastructure to developing products for everyday users, including a mobile app for private messaging and digital cash payments.

The platform will center on dotStables, starting with dotUSD, a U.S. dollar-pegged stablecoin backed by DOT and designed to drive demand for DOT as adoption grows. Polkadot will use user adoption and product usage as key measures of progress and direct more marketing funds toward campaigns tied to measurable user engagement. — link

谷歌Antigravity新增/run-workflow：一句话生成Python脚本，自动指挥多个AI干活

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌正在为 Antigravity 推出动态工作流功能 `/run-workflow`。用户只需描述任务，AI 就会自动编写 Python 脚本，安排多个 Agent 分工执行。哪些任务同时进行、哪些必须按顺序完成，都可以提前设定。

比如让 AI 检查一个大型代码项目，它可以安排多个 Agent 同时审查不同模块，再把发现的问题交给修复 Agent，最后统一运行测试。每个 Agent 的结果都能按规定格式传给下一步，减少任务执行过程中信息丢失、执行方向跑偏的问题。

生成的脚本可以在运行前由用户检查和修改，也能保存下来重复使用。以后遇到类似任务，直接运行同一套工作流，不必每次重新安排分工。

目前 `/run-workflow` 正逐步向 Antigravity App 和 CLI 的 Google AI Pro、Ultra 用户开放。

分析：比特币大跌未引发短期持有者恐慌性抛售，6.8万美元成为主要筹码承接位

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，加密分析师 Murphy 发文称，昨日 BTC 大跌后，短期持有者（STH）的高位套牢筹码仅小幅松动。数据显示，73,000 至 86,000 美元区间共有约 148 万枚 BTC，占 STH 总量的 68%，目前均处于浮亏状态，但昨日该区间筹码净减少仅 3.4 万枚，占比约 2.3%，表明大多数短期持有者并未因下跌恐慌性割肉。

具体来看，75,000 美元、80,000 美元和 85,000 美元成本区间分别减少 7,282 枚、8,481 枚和 5,441 枚 BTC，抛压相对分散。同时，STH 总量当日净增加 1.75 万枚，意味着部分长期持有者（LTH）也在下跌期间派发筹码。筹码承接主要集中在 68,000 美元，仅该价位区间就新增约 4.22 万枚 BTC。

盈利筹码方面，62,000 至 64,000 美元区间持有约 48 万枚 BTC，是目前 STH 中唯一规模较大的盈利筹码区间，昨日仅减少约 3,100 枚，不足 1%。Murphy 认为，该区间是下方最近的筹码支撑，若 BTC 跌入其中，短期持有者的盈利筹码将基本归零，市场情绪压力可能进一步上升。反之，若上方套牢盘继续保持稳定，价格后续仍有机会重新获得支撑。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377300

易理华：强烈支持黄仁勋回归英伟达，长期仍看好AI美股和加密市场

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，Liquid Capital 创始人易理华发文表示，强烈支持黄仁勋回归英伟达，认为黄仁勋不仅是 AI 行业的重要多头，也是整个 AI 生态的基础，其离开将是 AI 领域的巨大损失。JackYi 认为，黄仁勋离职长期来看不会改变 AI 行业发展趋势，但短期可能引发行业降杠杆和泡沫出清，令未来一段时间美股承压。

JackYi 还表示，黄仁勋离开引发的市场担忧可能延伸至其他科技行业领军人物，并认为 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 即将上市，或成为本轮 AI 市场狂欢的阶段性高点。若美股进一步大幅回调，巴菲特此前采取的现金策略可能再次体现价值。

在投资策略上，JackYi 表示，长期仍看好 AI 美股和加密市场，但短期选择等待机会。

items.content:
黄仁勋被曝曾误导英伟达总法律顾问，隐瞒与中国商人婚外情关系

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，路透社独家报道称，英伟达前 CEO 黄仁勋曾向公司多名高管，包括总法律顾问 Tim Teter 和首席营销官 Alison Wagonfeld，淡化其与中国商人 Alice Huang 的关系。路透社查阅的内部通信显示，黄仁勋在今年 10 月回应公司高管询问时，将双方互动描述为正常的客户业务往来，并强调与 Megaspeed International 的接触属于常规商业活动。

知情人士称，早在 2025 年《纽约时报》首次报道两人公开会面后，黄仁勋也曾向部分公司高管解释双方关系，但并未承认存在婚外情。他还曾讨论对《纽约时报》采取法律行动，但最终双方均未提起诉讼。

黄仁勋已于 11 月 12 日辞去英伟达 CEO 职务，此前他公开承认对妻子不忠并向公司致歉。英伟达董事会独立董事已聘请律所开展独立调查。英伟达股价较 10 月 6 日收盘高点已下跌逾 30%，市值蒸发超过 1.8 万亿美元。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377292

美交通部长：空管系统老旧硬件故障引发全国停飞，希望投入500亿美元升级

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，美国交通部长肖恩·达菲表示，此次美国全国范围航班停飞与空中交通管制系统的数据过载及老旧硬件故障有关，相关问题并非首次出现。他指出，停飞期间美国并未失去所有电信和雷达信号，但仍需要时间厘清故障的具体原因。

SpaceX盘后跌超2%，「星舰」第15次试飞，助推器未能按计划返回发射场

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，SpaceX 公司重型运载火箭「星舰」于美国中部时间 13 日下午实施第 15 次试飞，原计划首次尝试助推器和飞船均返回发射场，由发射塔机械臂实施「捕获」回收，但助推器未能按计划返回发射场。

美国中部时间 13 日 16 时 48 分许（北京时间 14 日 6 时 48 分许），「星舰」从位于得克萨斯州南部的发射基地升空。此后，火箭一二级分离。「超级重型」助推器未按原计划返回发射场，在墨西哥湾海域受控溅落。

SpaceX 周五收盘跌 0.59%，盘后跌 2.05%。暗盘现跌 0.93%，报 136.52 美元。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377290

美国全国地面停飞令即将解除，此前停飞令一度拖累美股及航空概念股

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，据 Air Current，美国全国范围的停飞令即将解除。

美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）今晨因特殊情况周五向所有机场发布全国地面停飞令后，追踪标普 500 指数的 ETF 盘后一度下跌 0.5%。追踪纳斯达克 100 指数的 ETF 盘后一度下跌 0.8%。航空股亦受此消息拖累走低，联合航空跌 1.2%，捷蓝航空跌 2.4%，美国航空跌 1.7%。相反，网络安全股上涨：Palo Alto 涨 2%，Zscaler 涨 1%，Crowdstrike 涨 2%。

此次停飞与空中交通管制（ATC）通信频率故障有关。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲此前表示，所有航路交通管制中心均受到通信问题影响，技术人员正在调查故障原因。美国联邦调查局（FBI）则认为，此次影响空管系统的通信故障并非由网络攻击或犯罪行为引起。目前，调查人员正排查故障是否与软件更新有关。

要求英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋职务的请愿网站访问量激增，超1.1万人签名

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，社交媒体上，要求英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋职务的请愿网站访问量激增，一度导致服务器过载。Replit CEO Amjad Masad 公开表示，他已联系该页面所有者，帮助提高速率限制，目前网站已恢复正常运行。

截至目前，该网站已有 11,098 人签署请愿，要求黄仁勋回归，其中包括 1,652 名现任员工、172 名前任员工和 6,544 名支持者。此前 2026 年 11 月 12 日，英伟达宣布黄仁勋辞去首席执行官职务，即刻生效。此举标志着他领导这家联合创立公司 33 年历程的结束。

本次活动组织者和签名者担心，黄仁勋可能在未经正当程序、甚至没有足够时间为自己申辩的情况下被迫离职，因此要求董事会作出解释。公开信核心诉求，致英伟达董事会：

· 在独立调查查明事实期间，恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务；如需继续离任，请提供有证据支持的解释。

· 确保调查独立、公开范围与时间表，并给予黄仁勋公平申辩机会。

· 及时作出公开说明，解释相关疑虑、证据及对员工和股东利益的权衡。

信件强调：「三十三年的领导不意味着免于问责，但问责需要证据和正当程序，而非群体公审。」网站声明该活动独立，未获英伟达或黄仁勋本人背书。

此前马斯克发文表示，要求恢复英伟达 (NVDA.O) 黄仁勋职务的请愿正在进行中，我也将签名支持。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，据 CNBC 报道，英伟达董事会表示，目前正在遴选一家猎头公司，负责寻找新任 CEO。董事会强调，尚未正式接触任何潜在候选人，目前有关继任人选的猜测为时过早。

英伟达发言人随后确认了这则消息的真实性。

今日早些时候，据英国《金融时报》援引知情人士报道，英伟达董事会在物色黄仁勋的正式继任者时，已接触软银旗下英国芯片设计公司 Arm CEO Rene Haas。Haas 是多名潜在人选之一，目前尚不确定英伟达是否会正式发出邀约，也不确定 Haas 是否会接受。Arm 拒绝置评，英伟达未立即回应置评请求。

Haas 曾在英伟达任职约七年，担任计算产品业务副总裁兼总经理。据知情人士透露，他离开英伟达十余年后，仍与黄仁勋及部分英伟达董事保持良好关系。Haas 于 2013 年加入 Arm，曾负责全球销售与营销，后出任 IP 产品集团总裁，自 2022 年 2 月起担任 Arm CEO 兼董事。

美联储12月加息预期基本确立，市场押注明年1月、3月继续加息

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，美联储官员本周密集发表鹰派言论，基本确立市场对 12 月加息 25 个基点的预期，并进一步打开明年 1 月连续加息的可能性。美国 10 月 CPI 显示通胀加速且价格压力扩大，10 月批发价格同比涨幅也升至 2022 年以来最高水平，进一步强化加息理由。

纽约联储主席威廉姆斯称通胀仍然过高，芝加哥联储主席古尔斯比称最新数据令人担忧，达拉斯联储主席洛根表示可能需要比此前预期更快加息，美联储理事沃勒则提出下月加息 50 个基点的可能性。市场目前已计入 12 月、明年 1 月和 3 月各加息 25 个基点，此前仅预计 12 月和明年 3 月加息。

美国银行已将未来三次会议均加息纳入预测，桑坦德则预计 12 月和明年 3 月加息。不过，官员对加息节奏仍存在分歧，部分官员主张逐步、小幅加息。波士顿联储主席柯林斯表示，进一步收紧政策的方向明确，但不愿提前判断加息幅度和速度。

加息预期升温推动美债收益率上涨，但住房市场疲软、AI 投资回报不及预期可能引发股市下跌，以及未来能源价格回落等因素，仍是美联储决策需要考虑的变量。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377282

OpenAI转向通用AI模型直接控制机器人，不再单独开发专用模型

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，据《财富》杂志报道，OpenAI 已解散独立机器人研究团队，并将相关研究人员重新分配至公司其他部门。OpenAI 表示，此举并非放弃机器人业务，而是为了加快通用机器人的研发。调整后，机器人研究人员将并入由首席研究官马克·陈领导的核心研究团队，应用机器人及硬件团队则转入由总裁格雷格·布罗克曼负责的应用部门。

此次调整反映出 OpenAI 战略方向的变化：公司认为，通用 AI 模型已能够直接应用于机器人控制，无需专门开发独立的机器人 AI 模型。OpenAI 称，包括 GPT-6Astra 在内的前沿通用模型已展现出机器人应用能力。英伟达一项研究显示，搭载 Astra 的智能体在模拟机器人操作测试中的成功率达到 74.8%，高于该排行榜上专用机器人模型此前报告的 51%。

OpenAI 仍计划开发人形机器人，CEO 奥尔特曼此前提出争取在 2027 年进行首次公开演示。不过，业内人士指出，通用模型仍存在运行速度较慢、依赖云端网络等局限，机器人企业在真实场景部署和积累数据方面仍具优势。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377280
items.title: OpenAI转向通用AI模型直接控制机器人，不再单独开发专用模型

美国FAA发布全国地面停飞令，空管通信故障引发航班暂停，FBI排除网络攻击

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 14 日，美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）今晨因特殊情况及安全原因发布全国范围地面停飞令，要求所有出港航班暂停起飞，直至另行通知，入境国际航班则根据具体情况逐一处理。

据 Air Current 报道，此次停飞与空中交通管制（ATC）通信频率故障有关。美国交通部长肖恩·达菲此前表示，所有航路交通管制中心均受到通信问题影响，技术人员正在调查故障原因。

美国联邦调查局（FBI）则认为，此次影响空管系统的通信故障并非由网络攻击或犯罪行为引起。目前，调查人员正排查故障是否与软件更新有关。

Coinbase Institutional: Fed Rate Expectations, Not Binance Hack, Drive Bitcoin’s Recent Decline

Coinbase Institutional said in its weekly report that Bitcoin’s recent decline was driven primarily by shifting Fed policy expectations rather than the Binance hack. October nonfarm payrolls and CPI both exceeded expectations, with markets fully pricing in a 25 bps rate hike in December and 64 bps of hikes over the next 12 months. Bitcoin fell below key support at $73,000, while stablecoin supply contracted by a record $11.5 billion over the past 30 days. U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $1.44 billion in net outflows over the five trading days leading up to Nov. 11, with ETF holders sitting on approximately $12.7 billion in aggregate unrealized losses. Coinbase Institutional warned that a sustained move below $73,000 would significantly increase the likelihood of a decline toward the $66,000–$68,000 support zone. — link

items.author: gvsi
items.content:
--- Top Comments ---

[gvsi]: I remember seeing a similar cool GIF for 9/11 flights, and thought it'd be cool to see if for today's ground stop too, and had Claude Code generate the website in ~30 mins. Liked it so much and thought I'd clean it up a bit, deploy, and share :) Enjoy!

[krferriter]: Very cool. Is this only commercial aircraft? Would be interesting to see if general aviation VFR craft also decreased even though they were technically still allowed to fly as long as it wasn’t from ATC controlled air strips. Though you wouldn’t be able to show it relative to the “expected” number of flights since they aren’t on scheduled flight routes.

[joshgermon]: I had the same idea ( https://germon.me/experiments/ground-stop/ ), this is awesome, great stuff Something about planes and data visualisation I love, been focus of so many of my random side projects

[halamadrid]: Really fast work! I didn't know all of this data was publicly available.

[cobychapple]: Fun irony (beyond being Friday the 13th): FAA lost radar and frequencies between centers but ADS-B is broadcast by the planes themselves, so a couple hundred hobbyist receivers probably kept the full picture the whole time.
